about: Organisations in the Algarve that a founder, a company or a student can turn to, compiled from PrompTugal.news public research. Organisations only: no private person is listed. Each entry keeps its source and the date it was read. Text CC BY 4.0 (PrompTugal.news); compiled by sites-dev@AgentiCCells.dinis with scripts/pages/_talent-map-data.mjs.

organisations.name: + Proximo teleassistance (Alcoutim council with the Tavira humanitarian centre of the Portuguese Red Cross)
organisations.what: Teleassistance for isolated people aged 65 or over, running since 2020, now paid by the council.
organisations.ai: Alarm devices and a support centre produce the data and the connection on which AI monitoring of isolated seniors would be built. No AI is mentioned.
organisations.pt: Teleassistência para pessoas isoladas com 65 ou mais anos, a funcionar desde 2020 e agora paga pela câmara.
organisations.es: Teleasistencia para personas aisladas de 65 años o más, en funcionamiento desde 2020 y ahora pagada por el ayuntamiento.
organisations.fr: Téléassistance pour les personnes isolées de 65 ans ou plus, en service depuis 2020 et désormais payée par la mairie.

organisations.name: ACRAL, Associação do Comércio e Serviços da Região do Algarve
organisations.what: Algarve commerce and services association, a consortium partner for Quarteira's digital commercial neighbourhood.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Associação do comércio e serviços do Algarve, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.es: Asociación del comercio y los servicios del Algarve, socia del consorcio del barrio comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.fr: Association du commerce et des services de l'Algarve, partenaire du consortium du quartier commerçant numérique de Quarteira.

organisations.name: ADJ3 Sistemas
organisations.what: Faro web and app developer that builds sites and portals for universities and municipalities on Drupal and React, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its site lists AI services integrated with Drupal: chatbots that answer from a site's own content, smart search, and assistants for content editors.
organisations.ai: It sells AI chatbots, search and editing assistants for public-interest websites.
organisations.pt: Empresa de Faro que desenvolve sites e aplicações, constrói sites e portais para universidades e municípios em Drupal e React, e é membro da Algarve Evolution. O seu site lista serviços de IA integrados com o Drupal: chatbots que respondem a partir do conteúdo do próprio site, pesquisa inteligente e assistentes para editores de conteúdo.
organisations.es: Empresa de Faro que desarrolla webs y aplicaciones, construye sitios y portales para universidades y municipios en Drupal y React, y es miembro de Algarve Evolution. Su web recoge servicios de IA integrados con Drupal: chatbots que responden a partir del contenido del propio sitio, búsqueda inteligente y asistentes para editores de contenido.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de Faro qui développe des sites et des applications, construit des sites et des portails pour des universités et des communes en Drupal et React, et est membre d'Algarve Evolution. Son site répertorie des services d'IA intégrés à Drupal : des chatbots qui répondent à partir du contenu du site, une recherche intelligente et des assistants pour les rédacteurs.

organisations.name: AEA, Associação de Empresários do Algarve
organisations.what: Algarve business association, a consortium partner for Quarteira's digital commercial neighbourhood.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Associação empresarial do Algarve, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.es: Asociación empresarial del Algarve, socia del consorcio del barrio comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.fr: Association d'entrepreneurs de l'Algarve, partenaire du consortium du quartier commerçant numérique de Quarteira.

organisations.name: AGROBOTICS-DITWINS
organisations.what: Interreg SUDOE project led by the University of Málaga, with 13 partners from Spain, Portugal and France, building robotics, AI and digital-twin living labs for agriculture to May 2028. NERA and UAlg lead the Algarve pilot.
organisations.ai: The project tests AI and robotics on farms.
organisations.pt: Projeto Interreg SUDOE liderado pela Universidade de Málaga, com 13 parceiros de Espanha, Portugal e França, que cria laboratórios vivos de robótica, IA e gémeos digitais para a agricultura até maio de 2028. A NERA e a UAlg lideram o piloto do Algarve.
organisations.es: Proyecto Interreg SUDOE liderado por la Universidad de Málaga, con 13 socios de España, Portugal y Francia, que crea laboratorios vivos de robótica, IA y gemelos digitales para la agricultura hasta mayo de 2028. NERA y la UAlg lideran el piloto del Algarve.
organisations.fr: Projet Interreg SUDOE mené par l'Université de Malaga, avec 13 partenaires d'Espagne, du Portugal et de France, qui crée des laboratoires vivants de robotique, d'IA et de jumeaux numériques pour l'agriculture jusqu'en mai 2028. La NERA et l'UAlg mènent le pilote de l'Algarve.

organisations.name: Agrosocial Plus (Interreg Spain-Portugal, Odiana as Lower Guadiana partner)
organisations.what: A cross-border agrifood social economy and innovation project coordinated by the Diputacion de Cordoba, planning Living Labs for AI, IoT and smart irrigation.
organisations.ai: The labs are planned to test AI directly. No lab location in Alcoutim is confirmed.
organisations.pt: Projeto transfronteiriço de economia social e inovação agroalimentar, coordenado pela Diputación de Córdoba, que prevê laboratórios vivos de IA, IoT e rega inteligente.
organisations.es: Proyecto transfronterizo de economía social e innovación agroalimentaria, coordinado por la Diputación de Córdoba, que prevé laboratorios vivos de IA, IoT y riego inteligente.
organisations.fr: Projet transfrontalier d'économie sociale et d'innovation agroalimentaire, coordonné par la Diputación de Córdoba, qui prévoit des laboratoires vivants d'IA, d'IoT et d'irrigation intelligente.

organisations.name: AI Aumentar, Lda.
organisations.what: Listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. The member page gives no description and links to concha-ai.com, a decision-intelligence product for leadership hiring, but that site does not mention AI Aumentar, so the link between them is unconfirmed. Needs its own source.
organisations.ai: Its name points to AI, which is unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Listada como membro da Algarve Evolution. A página de membros não indica descrição, concelho nem produto: o nome sugere uma área de IA, que não confirmámos. Precisa de fonte própria.
organisations.es: Figura como miembro de Algarve Evolution. La página de miembros no indica descripción, municipio ni producto: el nombre sugiere un área de IA, que no hemos confirmado. Necesita una fuente propia.
organisations.fr: Répertoriée comme membre d'Algarve Evolution. La page des membres n'indique ni description, ni commune, ni produit : le nom évoque un domaine lié à l'IA, ce que nous n'avons pas confirmé. Il lui faut une source propre.

organisations.name: AI4Youth Work (Erasmus+ project, with Contextos and Algarve STP)
organisations.what: An Erasmus+ project to help youth workers use AI tools, with partners in Portugal, Greece, Italy and Romania. Its Algarve session was held at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 2 April 2025.
organisations.ai: A European project on AI for youth work, presented in Faro.
organisations.pt: Um projeto Erasmus+ para ajudar animadores juvenis a usar ferramentas de IA, com parceiros em Portugal, na Grécia, em Itália e na Roménia. A sessão no Algarve realizou-se no UALG TEC Campus, em Faro, a 2 de abril de 2025.
organisations.es: Un proyecto Erasmus+ para ayudar a los animadores juveniles a usar herramientas de IA, con socios en Portugal, Grecia, Italia y Rumanía. La sesión en el Algarve se celebró en el UALG TEC Campus, en Faro, el 2 de abril de 2025.
organisations.fr: Un projet Erasmus+ pour aider les animateurs jeunesse à utiliser des outils d'IA, avec des partenaires au Portugal, en Grèce, en Italie et en Roumanie. La séance en Algarve a eu lieu au UALG TEC Campus, à Faro, le 2 avril 2025.

organisations.name: Alcoutim Business Park (Parque Empresarial de Alcoutim)
organisations.what: The council's industrial estate: 54,320 square metres in 26 lots, 23 of them for industrial units, between the EN 122, the EN 124 and the new IC27, about 30 kilometres from the coast and Spain and about 6 kilometres from the town. The council publishes the park's regulation as a PDF on the same page, and the page is dated 4 November 2025.
organisations.pt: A zona industrial da câmara: 54.320 metros quadrados em 26 lotes, 23 para unidades industriais, entre a EN 122, a EN 124 e o novo IC27. A câmara publica o regulamento do parque na mesma página.
organisations.es: La zona industrial del ayuntamiento: 54.320 metros cuadrados en 26 parcelas, 23 para unidades industriales, entre la EN 122, la EN 124 y el nuevo IC27. El ayuntamiento publica el reglamento del parque en la misma página.
organisations.fr: La zone industrielle de la mairie : 54 320 mètres carrés en 26 lots, dont 23 pour des unités industrielles, entre l'EN 122, l'EN 124 et le nouvel IC27. La mairie publie le règlement du parc sur la même page.

organisations.name: ALGAR, Valorização e Tratamento de Resíduos Sólidos
organisations.what: Waste company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Almancil, which serves the whole Algarve. With the start-up NILG.AI it built an AI tool that chooses sites for recycling points, piloted in Lagoa. UPTEC's page says the pilot also covers São Brás de Alportel.
organisations.ai: It builds and runs an AI tool for site selection.
organisations.pt: Empresa de resíduos fundada em 1995, com sede em Almancil, que serve todo o Algarve. Com a startup NILG.AI criou uma ferramenta de IA que escolhe locais para ecopontos, testada em Lagoa.
organisations.es: Empresa de residuos fundada en 1995, con sede en Almancil, que da servicio a todo el Algarve. Con la startup NILG.AI creó una herramienta de IA que elige ubicaciones para puntos de reciclaje, probada en Lagoa.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de gestion des déchets fondée en 1995, basée à Almancil, qui dessert tout l'Algarve. Avec la start-up NILG.AI, elle a créé un outil d'IA qui choisit l'emplacement des points de tri, testé à Lagoa.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 (FEDER) in the council's digitisation project
organisations.what: EU regional funding for digital infrastructure, online services and cybersecurity at the council.
organisations.ai: Groundwork for AI in services, not AI itself.
organisations.pt: Fundos regionais europeus para infraestrutura digital, serviços online e cibersegurança na câmara.
organisations.es: Fondos regionales europeos para infraestructura digital, servicios en línea y ciberseguridad en el ayuntamiento.
organisations.fr: Fonds régionaux européens pour l'infrastructure numérique, les services en ligne et la cybersécurité à la mairie.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 and Algarve Empreende 2026
organisations.what: Regional programme money behind Venture Lab, UAlg's proof-of-concept programme, and the AI and robotics pilot for 15 tourism SMEs.
organisations.ai: Pays for AI adoption and mentoring programmes run from Faro: one step from AI.
organisations.pt: Fundos do programa regional por trás do Venture Lab, do programa de prova de conceito da UAlg e do piloto de IA e robótica para 15 PME do turismo.
organisations.es: Fondos del programa regional detrás del Venture Lab, del programa de prueba de concepto de la UAlg y del piloto de IA y robótica para 15 pymes del turismo.
organisations.fr: Fonds du programme régional derrière le Venture Lab, le programme de preuve de concept de l'UAlg et le pilote d'IA et de robotique pour 15 PME du tourisme.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme
organisations.what: Co-finances half of the more than 3.5 million euro Estádio Algarve technology centre and the Inova Algarve 3.0 AI and robotics pilot for tourism firms.
organisations.ai: The centre lists AI among its themes: the funding, then the centre, then AI firms.
organisations.amount: more than 3.5 million euros total, 50% Algarve 2030
organisations.pt: Cofinancia metade do centro tecnológico do Estádio Algarve, de mais de 3,5 milhões de euros, e o piloto de IA e robótica Inova Algarve 3.0 para empresas do turismo.
organisations.es: Cofinancia la mitad del centro tecnológico del Estádio Algarve, de más de 3,5 millones de euros, y el piloto de IA y robótica Inova Algarve 3.0 para empresas del turismo.
organisations.fr: Cofinance la moitié du centre technologique de l'Estádio Algarve, de plus de 3,5 millions d'euros, et le pilote d'IA et de robotique Inova Algarve 3.0 pour les entreprises du tourisme.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme (FEDER) in the Celeiro de Ideias centre
organisations.what: EU regional funding for the council's business and coworking centre.
organisations.ai: It pays for the space where startups would sit. No AI tenant is announced.
organisations.pt: Fundos regionais europeus para o centro de empresas e coworking da câmara.
organisations.es: Fondos regionales europeos para el centro de empresas y coworking del ayuntamiento.
organisations.fr: Fonds régionaux européens pour le centre d'entreprises et l'espace de coworking de la mairie.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 territorial incentive scheme (SIBT), notice ALGARVE-2026-5
organisations.what: A 5 million euro call for micro and small companies to create, expand or modernise, with up to 60 percent co-financing and special weight for inland, low-density territories. Priority areas include digitalisation and information and communication technologies. Applications are open until 15 January 2027, assessed in rounds ending 30 July, 30 October 2026 and 15 January 2027. The council posts the notice on its own site.
organisations.pt: Aviso de 5 milhões de euros para micro e pequenas empresas criarem, expandirem ou modernizarem, com cofinanciamento até 60 por cento e peso especial para territórios do interior. Candidaturas abertas até 15 de janeiro de 2027.
organisations.es: Convocatoria de 5 millones de euros para que micro y pequeñas empresas se creen, se amplíen o se modernicen, con cofinanciación de hasta el 60 por ciento y un peso especial para los territorios del interior. Solicitudes abiertas hasta el 15 de enero de 2027.
organisations.fr: Appel de 5 millions d'euros pour que des micro et petites entreprises se créent, se développent ou se modernisent, avec un cofinancement jusqu'à 60 pour cent et un poids particulier pour les territoires de l'intérieur. Candidatures ouvertes jusqu'au 15 janvier 2027.

organisations.name: Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub (Alcoutim, Olhao, Loule, Sao Bras de Alportel, Tavira, Vila Real de Santo Antonio)
organisations.what: A PRR project of six municipalities to build an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network, including monitoring of isolated elderly residents. Alcoutim's assigned funding is 124.32 thousand euros, and the project is due to end on 30 June 2026.
organisations.ai: Sensors and a LoRaWAN network feed one data platform, and a shared data platform is where analytics and AI services get built. The project page does not mention AI.

also.what: Intermunicipal recovery-plan project with six Algarve councils to set up an urban management platform and digital tools.

A PRR digital public administration project of 1.13 million euros, run through the state's technological reform agency, to put an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network in six Algarve municipalities. Vila Real de Santo António is assigned 140.74 thousand euros, with nothing spent on the day we read the page. Planned areas include incident management, waste, water use, air quality, green spaces and monitoring isolated elderly residents. The page gives an expected end date of 30 June 2026.

PRR-funded project (1.13 million euros, September 2023 to June 2026) to put an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network across six municipalities: Olhão, Alcoutim, Loulé, São Brás de Alportel, Tavira and Vila Real de Santo António. Town files name it in their own words.

organisations.pt: Projeto PRR de seis municípios para uma plataforma de gestão urbana com sensores e rede LoRaWAN, incluindo o acompanhamento de idosos isolados.
organisations.es: Proyecto PRR de seis municipios para una plataforma de gestión urbana con sensores y red LoRaWAN, que incluye el seguimiento de personas mayores aisladas.
organisations.fr: Projet PRR de six communes pour une plateforme de gestion urbaine avec capteurs et réseau LoRaWAN, qui comprend le suivi des personnes âgées isolées.

organisations.name: Algarve AI Agents
organisations.what: An AI community that BeAlgarve's ecosystem directory lists for Faro and Loulé. We found no page of its own, so its activity is unverified.
organisations.ai: A community dedicated to AI, as listed by the directory.

also.what: An AI community covering Faro and Loulé, as BeAlgarve lists it. No page of its own found yet.

Community listed as AI-related in the Algarve entrepreneurship ecosystem directory and, per our newsroom, part of the Algarve Digital Innovators network. The directory gives no website: needs a primary source.

organisations.pt: Comunidade de IA que o diretório do ecossistema BeAlgarve indica em Faro e Loulé. Não encontrámos página própria, por isso a sua atividade não está verificada.
organisations.es: Comunidad de IA que el directorio del ecosistema BeAlgarve sitúa en Faro y Loulé. No encontramos una página propia, así que su actividad no está verificada.
organisations.fr: Communauté d'IA que l'annuaire de l'écosystème BeAlgarve situe à Faro et Loulé. Nous n'avons pas trouvé de page propre, son activité n'est donc pas vérifiée.

organisations.name: Algarve Digital Innovators
organisations.what: Network of digital communities across the Algarve, supported by Algarve Evolution. Reported to include GDG Faro, Flutter Faro and Algarve AI Agents (our own newsroom's reading, to be re-checked at source).
organisations.ai: The network includes AI and developer communities.
organisations.pt: Rede de comunidades digitais em todo o Algarve, apoiada pela Algarve Evolution.
organisations.es: Red de comunidades digitales en todo el Algarve, apoyada por Algarve Evolution.
organisations.fr: Réseau de communautés numériques dans tout l'Algarve, soutenu par Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: Algarve Evolution
organisations.what: Association of entrepreneurs, talent and startups (106 active members by its own count) building an innovation ecosystem in the Algarve. Ran Vibathon Algarve 2026 in Faro on 31 October, runs the AI and Robotics programme for 15 tourism SMEs, and hosts events in Faro including one on UAlgTec Heritage on 17 November. Its pages do not state a base city.
organisations.ai: Runs an AI and robotics adoption programme and the regional digital ecosystem.

also.what: Lists an incubator, the Founder2Founder growth programme and INOVA Algarve 3.0 for tourism firms adopting AI and robotics.
Regional association of more than 100 professionals and companies, partner of GDG Lagos events, with an AI and Robotics project for tourism SMEs.

Regional association named as one of the stakeholders engaged to link the November 2026 TMCT conference in Portimão to regional business, institutional and education partners. Its exact role is not stated in the source.

Faro-based association of entrepreneurs, talent, startups, SMEs and partners that runs the Algarve Innovation Hub and incubator. It runs the regional AI adoption survey and the AI and robotics tourism programme, co-organised the Vibathon with Lovable, and its incubator takes technical founders building AI and software products.

organisations.pt: Associação de empreendedores, talento e startups (106 membros ativos, segundo a própria) que constrói um ecossistema de inovação no Algarve. Organizou o Vibathon Algarve 2026 em Faro a 31 de outubro e gere o programa de IA e Robótica para 15 PME do turismo.
organisations.es: Asociación de emprendedores, talento y startups (106 miembros activos, según ella misma) que construye un ecosistema de innovación en el Algarve. Organizó el Vibathon Algarve 2026 en Faro el 31 de octubre y gestiona el programa de IA y Robótica para 15 pymes del turismo.
organisations.fr: Association d'entrepreneurs, de talents et de start-up (106 membres actifs, selon elle) qui construit un écosystème d'innovation en Algarve. Elle a organisé le Vibathon Algarve 2026 à Faro le 31 octobre et gère le programme IA et Robotique pour 15 PME du tourisme.

organisations.name: Algarve Innovation and Technology Park (PPPITA), Pechão
organisations.what: Planned 48.58 hectare park in Pechão for technology companies, education and research, health and green space, with land for 548 public homes. A contract signed in August 2024 started its detailed plan, with 18 months for the landowner to finalise it. Whether it has progressed since is not confirmed.
organisations.ai: A site meant for technology companies, where AI firms could locate. The article names no AI sector: a 3-step entry, labelled as a plan.
organisations.pt: Parque planeado de 48,58 hectares em Pechão para empresas de tecnologia, ensino e investigação, saúde e espaços verdes. Não está confirmado se avançou desde 2024.
organisations.es: Parque previsto de 48,58 hectáreas en Pechão para empresas de tecnología, enseñanza e investigación, salud y espacios verdes. No está confirmado si ha avanzado desde 2024.
organisations.fr: Parc prévu de 48,58 hectares à Pechão pour des entreprises de technologie, d'enseignement et de recherche, de santé, et des espaces verts. Il n'est pas confirmé qu'il ait avancé depuis 2024.

organisations.name: Algarve Smart Destination, Digital Innovation Hub
organisations.what: An informal network led by the non-profit Algarve STP, in the European Commission's hub catalogue. Loulé is one of its three partner municipalities, with Faro and Olhão, alongside the University of the Algarve, ANJE, Algarve Evolution, Altis and Fraunhofer Portugal. Its focus areas include AI and deep learning for tourism and digital marketing. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.
organisations.ai: Loulé is a partner municipality of a hub whose focus areas include AI for tourism.
organisations.pt: Uma rede informal liderada pelo Algarve STP, entidade sem fins lucrativos, que consta do catálogo de polos da Comissão Europeia. Loulé é um dos seus três municípios parceiros, com Faro e Olhão, ao lado da Universidade do Algarve, da ANJE, da Algarve Evolution, da Altis e da Fraunhofer Portugal. As suas áreas incluem IA e aprendizagem profunda para o turismo e o marketing digital. Encontrada pelo detective.places@ e lida por nós a 16 de novembro de 2026.
organisations.es: Una red informal liderada por Algarve STP, entidad sin ánimo de lucro, que figura en el catálogo de polos de la Comisión Europea. Loulé es uno de sus tres municipios socios, con Faro y Olhão, junto a la Universidad del Algarve, ANJE, Algarve Evolution, Altis y Fraunhofer Portugal. Sus áreas incluyen IA y aprendizaje profundo para el turismo y el marketing digital. Encontrada por detective.places@ y leída por nosotros el 16 de noviembre de 2026.
organisations.fr: Un réseau informel mené par l'Algarve STP, organisme à but non lucratif, qui figure au catalogue des pôles de la Commission européenne. Loulé est l'une de ses trois communes partenaires, avec Faro et Olhão, aux côtés de l'Université de l'Algarve, de l'ANJE, d'Algarve Evolution, d'Altis et de Fraunhofer Portugal. Ses domaines comprennent l'IA et l'apprentissage profond pour le tourisme et le marketing numérique. Trouvé par detective.places@ et lu par nous le 16 novembre 2026.

organisations.name: Algarve STP
organisations.what: Science and technology park association that ran the first Venture Lab (12 firms, AI among the sectors) and co-hosted the July 2026 AI panel at UALG TEC Campus.
organisations.ai: Mentors AI startups and hosts AI events.

also.what: Regional technology and innovation body, a named organiser of the Algarve Tech Hub Summit held in Lagos in November 2025.

Named as partner of the July 2026 Faro AI search panel and as support for the UAlgTec Heritage presentation, and as promoter of the Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP, a free mentoring programme for 12 Algarve startups and SMEs funded by ALGARVE 2030. Its own site serves a bot challenge to automated readers, so its role is read through the press.

partner.note: Science and technology park; partner in ADI, Venture Lab, the Tech Hub Summit and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: Associação de parque de ciência e tecnologia que organizou o primeiro Venture Lab (12 empresas, com a IA entre os setores) e coorganizou o painel de IA de julho de 2026 no UALG TEC Campus.
organisations.es: Asociación de parque científico y tecnológico que organizó el primer Venture Lab (12 empresas, con la IA entre los sectores) y coorganizó el panel de IA de julio de 2026 en el UALG TEC Campus.
organisations.fr: Association de parc scientifique et technologique qui a organisé le premier Venture Lab (12 entreprises, avec l'IA parmi les secteurs) et coorganisé la table ronde sur l'IA de juillet 2026 au UALG TEC Campus.

organisations.name: Altice Labs, Olhão hub
organisations.what: Altice Labs opened its Algarve hub in Olhão on 12 May 2021. Projects were already running, some with the University of Algarve, including AI algorithms for studying the retina.
organisations.ai: Reported AI work on retina images with the University of Algarve (2021 report).
organisations.pt: A Altice Labs abriu o seu polo do Algarve em Olhão a 12 de maio de 2021, com projetos já em curso, alguns com a Universidade do Algarve.
organisations.es: Altice Labs abrió su polo del Algarve en Olhão el 12 de mayo de 2021, con proyectos ya en marcha, algunos con la Universidad del Algarve.
organisations.fr: Altice Labs a ouvert son pôle de l'Algarve à Olhão le 12 mai 2021, avec des projets déjà en cours, certains avec l'Université de l'Algarve.

organisations.name: AMAL, the Algarve intermunicipal community
organisations.what: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

partner.note: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: A comunidade intermunicipal do Algarve; parceira da ADI, do Venture Lab e do projeto Web Summit 2025.
organisations.es: La comunidad intermunicipal del Algarve; socia de la ADI, del Venture Lab y del proyecto Web Summit 2025.
organisations.fr: La communauté intercommunale de l'Algarve ; partenaire de l'ADI, du Venture Lab et du projet Web Summit 2025.

organisations.name: ANJE, national association of young entrepreneurs
organisations.what: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

partner.note: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

organisations.pt: Associação nacional de jovens empresários; parceira da ADI e do Venture Lab; organizou o concurso Web Summit 2025.
organisations.es: Asociación nacional de jóvenes empresarios; socia de la ADI y del Venture Lab; organizó el concurso Web Summit 2025.

organisations.name: Artificial Intelligence Algarve
organisations.what: Community that appears as an 'AIA Artificial Intelligence Algarve' category on Algarve Evolution's events page and is listed as AI-related in the BEALG ecosystem directory. The events page showed no event under it when read. Needs its own public page.
organisations.ai: Its name and the events category are about AI.

organisations.es: Comunidad que figura como vinculada a la IA en el directorio del ecosistema emprendedor del Algarve. Necesita una fuente pública primaria.
organisations.fr: Communauté répertoriée comme liée à l'IA dans l'annuaire de l'écosystème entrepreneurial de l'Algarve. Il lui faut une source publique primaire.

organisations.name: Associação de Empresários Por Quarteira
organisations.what: Local business association of Quarteira, a consortium partner for the digital commercial neighbourhood.

organisations.pt: Associação empresarial local de Quarteira, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital.
organisations.es: Asociación empresarial local de Quarteira, socia del consorcio del barrio comercial digital.
organisations.fr: Association d'entrepreneurs locale de Quarteira, partenaire du consortium du quartier commerçant numérique.

organisations.name: Associação de Municípios Loulé/Faro (Estádio Algarve centre)
organisations.what: Joint body of the two councils tendering a technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that names AI among its themes.
organisations.ai: It is building a tech centre that lists AI among its themes.

organisations.es: Entidad conjunta de los dos ayuntamientos que lanzó el concurso de un centro tecnológico en el Estádio Algarve que incluye la IA entre sus temas.
organisations.fr: Entité commune des deux mairies qui a lancé l'appel d'offres d'un centre technologique à l'Estádio Algarve, dont l'IA fait partie des thèmes.

organisations.name: Associacao Odiana
organisations.what: Local development association named by the Galp Foundation as social partner in Alcoutim, helping run Vilas em Movimento including its senior-isolation activities. Portuguese partner for the Lower Guadiana in the Agrosocial Plus project.

organisations.es: Asociación de desarrollo local, socia social de la Fundação Galp en Alcoutim en Vilas em Movimento, y socia portuguesa del Bajo Guadiana en el proyecto Agrosocial Plus.
organisations.fr: Association de développement local, partenaire sociale de la Fundação Galp à Alcoutim dans Vilas em Movimento, et partenaire portugaise du Bas Guadiana dans le projet Agrosocial Plus.

organisations.name: AuroraMed
organisations.what: Portuguese health-tech company applying AI to clinical management, which launched an AI course with UAlg's medical faculty in Faro.
organisations.ai: Sells AI for healthcare and trains its leaders.

also.what: Portuguese healthtech focused on AI in clinical management, partner of the UAlg healthcare AI executive course. The article does not say where it is based: location to confirm.

organisations.pt: Empresa portuguesa de tecnologia da saúde que aplica IA à gestão clínica e lançou um curso de IA com a faculdade de medicina da UAlg, em Faro.
organisations.es: Empresa portuguesa de tecnología sanitaria que aplica la IA a la gestión clínica y lanzó un curso de IA con la facultad de medicina de la UAlg, en Faro.
organisations.fr: Entreprise portugaise de technologie de la santé qui applique l'IA à la gestion clinique et a lancé un cours d'IA avec la faculté de médecine de l'UAlg, à Faro.

organisations.name: Ayuntamiento de Ayamonte
organisations.what: Spanish council across the river, in the Eurocidade with VRSA. In March 2024 it said it was preparing an AI virtual assistant and a Eurocidade innovation node. It sits outside the municipality and is listed as the cross-border neighbour.

organisations.pt: Câmara espanhola do outro lado do rio, na Eurocidade com VRSA. Em março de 2024 disse estar a preparar um assistente virtual com IA. Está fora do município e é listada como vizinha transfronteiriça.
organisations.es: Ayuntamiento español al otro lado del río, en la Eurociudad con VRSA. En marzo de 2024 dijo que preparaba un asistente virtual con IA. Está fuera del municipio y figura como vecino transfronterizo.
organisations.fr: Mairie espagnole de l'autre côté du fleuve, dans l'Eurocité avec VRSA. En mars 2024, elle a dit préparer un assistant virtuel avec IA. Elle est hors de la commune et figure comme voisine transfrontalière.

organisations.name: B.Efficient
organisations.what: Runs EMARP's active leak-detection campaign over 130 km of the public water network. Its location is not stated in the source.

organisations.pt: Faz a campanha de deteção ativa de fugas da EMARP em 130 km da rede pública de água. A fonte não indica a sua localização.
organisations.es: Realiza la campaña de detección activa de fugas de EMARP en 130 km de la red pública de agua. La fuente no indica su ubicación.
organisations.fr: Mène la campagne de détection active des fuites d'EMARP sur 130 km du réseau public d'eau. La source n'indique pas où elle se trouve.

organisations.name: Bairro Comercial Digital de Quarteira (Câmara de Loulé, ACRAL, IAPMEI)
organisations.what: A PRR project of 1.01 million euros, 2023 to 2025, for online shops, a digital tourist guide and smart signage, run by the Loulé council with the Algarve commerce association ACRAL.
organisations.ai: Digitising local shops creates the data and skills AI retail tools need. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Projeto PRR de 1,01 milhões de euros, de 2023 a 2025, para lojas online, um guia turístico digital e sinalética inteligente, gerido pela Câmara de Loulé com a ACRAL.
organisations.es: Proyecto PRR de 1,01 millones de euros, de 2023 a 2025, para tiendas en línea, una guía turística digital y señalización inteligente, gestionado por el Ayuntamiento de Loulé con ACRAL.
organisations.fr: Projet PRR de 1,01 million d'euros, de 2023 à 2025, pour des boutiques en ligne, un guide touristique numérique et une signalétique intelligente, géré par la mairie de Loulé avec l'ACRAL.

organisations.name: Bot Gonçalves
organisations.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that uses AI and satellite imagery to monitor critical infrastructure. The article gives no town: needs a primary source.
organisations.ai: Its product is AI applied to satellite imagery.
organisations.pt: Empresa do Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP que usa IA e imagens de satélite para monitorizar infraestruturas críticas. O artigo não indica o concelho.
organisations.es: Empresa del Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP que usa IA e imágenes de satélite para vigilar infraestructuras críticas. El artículo no indica el municipio.
organisations.fr: Entreprise du Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP qui utilise l'IA et l'imagerie satellite pour surveiller des infrastructures critiques. L'article n'indique pas la commune.

organisations.what: Council that said in 2023 it was working on AI-optimised waste routes and smart parking, and in 2026 launched the digital commerce project Olhão com Alma.

organisations.pt: Câmara que em 2023 disse estar a trabalhar em rotas de resíduos e estacionamento inteligente com IA e que em 2026 lançou o projeto de comércio digital Olhão com Alma.

organisations.what: Business centre and incubator in central Tavira, run by the municipal company EMPET, housing the town's Espaço Empresa service point (gov.pt) and listed as an accredited incubator on IAPMEI's November 2018 Vale Incubação list.

organisations.es: Centro de negocios e incubadora en el centro de Tavira, gestionado por la empresa municipal EMPET, con la ventanilla Espaço Empresa, e incubadora acreditada en la lista Vale Incubação del IAPMEI de 2018.
organisations.fr: Centre d'affaires et incubateur au centre de Tavira, géré par l'entreprise municipale EMPET, avec le guichet Espaço Empresa, et incubateur accrédité sur la liste Vale Incubação de l'IAPMEI de 2018.

organisations.name: CEOT (Centro de Eletrónica, Optoelectrónica e Telecomunicações, UAlg)

organisations.fr: Centre de recherche de l'UAlg qui a coorganisé en 2024 un atelier sur l'apprentissage profond appliqué au contrôle alimentaire.

organisations.name: CIAC (UAlg research centre in arts and communication)
organisations.what: UAlg centre that opened the INTERFACE digital translation lab in Faro in October 2026, with an AI Studio extension at its Santarém hub.

organisations.name: CIMA, Universidade do Algarve (SIMPATICO monitoring buoy)
organisations.what: The University of the Algarve's marine and environmental research centre runs SIMPATICO, an autonomous buoy at the mouth of the Guadiana estuary on the Portugal and Spain border. It has recorded currents, water level and water quality every hour and every 15 minutes since March 2008, and the data are open on PANGAEA. The centre is based at the university, not in the municipality.
organisations.ai: A long, open, high-frequency sensor series at the town's river mouth is the kind of dataset used to train and test forecasting models. The page mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: O centro de investigação marinha e ambiental da Universidade do Algarve opera a SIMPATICO, uma boia autónoma na foz do Guadiana que regista correntes, nível e qualidade da água desde 2008, com dados abertos.
organisations.es: El centro de investigación marina y ambiental de la Universidad del Algarve opera SIMPATICO, una boya autónoma en la desembocadura del Guadiana que registra corrientes, nivel y calidad del agua desde 2008, con datos abiertos.
organisations.fr: Le centre de recherche marine et environnementale de l'Université de l'Algarve exploite SIMPATICO, une bouée autonome à l'embouchure du Guadiana qui enregistre les courants, le niveau et la qualité de l'eau depuis 2008, avec des données ouvertes.

organisations.name: CITAI-FABXR ISMAT
organisations.what: ISMAT research and making group that runs the Fabricating Futures workshop on 3D printing, biofabrication and advanced manufacturing.

organisations.name: CME (digital platform for the Alcoutim shared bikes)

organisations.ai: A software platform that collects usage data is a step from data products and AI features. The article does not say CME uses AI.

organisations.fr: L'entreprise indiquée comme créatrice de la plateforme numérique des vélos électriques partagés, ouverts en juin 2026.

organisations.es: Descrito en una guía de Outsite (junio de 2026) como un pequeño coworking comunitario cerca de la Praia do Amado. Otras listas dicen que Aljezur no tiene coworking, así que hay que confirmarlo.
organisations.fr: Décrit dans un guide d'Outsite (juin 2026) comme un petit coworking communautaire près de la Praia do Amado. D'autres listes disent qu'Aljezur n'a pas de coworking, il faut donc le confirmer.

organisations.es: El ayuntamiento dice que los abrió a finales de 2021. Un artículo de opinión de 2025 afirmaba que Silves no tenía incubadora, aceleradora ni centro de negocios, así que no hemos confirmado ninguno de ellos.

organisations.name: DETAILS, Hospitality, Sports, Leisure (Arrow Global, Vilamoura)
organisations.what: Manages Arrow Global's hospitality, sports and leisure assets in Portugal, including Vilamoura's golf courses, and brought Trackman ball tracking to the Old Course in 2025.
organisations.ai: The operator of Vilamoura's courses deploys sensor and data technology, a base for analytics. No AI claimed in the source.

organisations.fr: Projet Interreg Espace Atlantique (2026 à 2028, environ 2,13 millions d'euros) sur la capacité numérique et la nutrition de précision en aquaculture, mené par S2AQUA avec SPAROS, l'IPMA et des universités.

organisations.fr: La page des appels de la mairie répertorie des financements nationaux comme Smart PME (Industrie 4.0), Coaching 4.0 et des chèques pour les start-up aux produits verts et numériques. Les titres ne mentionnent pas l'IA et la page n'indique pas de dates : vérifiez chaque appel à sa source.

organisations.fr: Répertoriée comme membre d'Algarve Evolution. La page des membres n'indique ni description ni commune : le nom évoque la science des données, et nous n'avons pas confirmé ce qu'elle fait en Algarve. Il lui faut une source propre.

organisations.name: ePaper by Mind (vendor whose client logos include Loulé)
organisations.what: Mind's digital urban-planning platform. Its page shows a 'Loulé' logo among 27 municipal client logos and names AI features: document checks at online reception, an AI error check before a request is filed, and an AI agent announced on 13 October 2026. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.

organisations.pt: A plataforma digital de urbanismo da Mind. A sua página mostra um logótipo de 'Loulé' entre 27 logótipos de clientes municipais e indica funções de IA: verificação de documentos no atendimento online, uma verificação de erros com IA antes de submeter um pedido e um agente de IA anunciado a 13 de outubro de 2026. A página nada diz sobre o que Loulé usa, e a câmara não indicou as ferramentas de IA que contratou para o urbanismo, por isso não ligamos as duas. Encontrada pelo detective.places@ e lida por nós a 16 de novembro de 2026.
organisations.es: La plataforma digital de urbanismo de Mind. Su página muestra un logotipo de 'Loulé' entre 27 logotipos de clientes municipales e indica funciones de IA: comprobación de documentos en la atención en línea, una comprobación de errores con IA antes de presentar una solicitud y un agente de IA anunciado el 13 de octubre de 2026. La página no dice nada sobre lo que usa Loulé, y el ayuntamiento no ha indicado las herramientas de IA que contrató para el urbanismo, así que no relacionamos las dos. Sa page montre un logo 'Loulé' parmi 27 logos de clients municipaux et indique des fonctions d'IA : vérification des documents à l'accueil en ligne, un contrôle d'erreurs avec IA avant le dépôt d'une demande et un agent d'IA annoncé le 13 octobre 2026. La page ne dit rien de ce qu'utilise Loulé, et la mairie n'a pas indiqué les outils d'IA qu'elle a acquis pour l'urbanisme : nous ne relions donc pas les deux. Trouvée par detective.places@ et lue par nous le 16 novembre 2026.
