organisations.es: Proyecto transfronterizo Interreg España-Portugal liderado por la Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, con NERA como socia. Apoyó el Lunch & Learn sobre herramientas de IA, en Faro, el 10 de noviembre.
organisations.fr: Projet transfrontalier Interreg Espagne-Portugal mené par la Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, avec la NERA comme partenaire. Il a soutenu le Lunch & Learn sur les outils d'IA, à Faro, le 10 novembre.

organisations.name: Invisible CFO
organisations.what: Portuguese fintech founded in 2024 and based in Monchique, a digital finance provider for small businesses and freelancers. By its own account it combines AI, automation and a human team, and says 300,000 euros of EU funding helped develop its AI and automation applications. Named an Impact Startup 2025.
organisations.ai: Its product uses AI directly in financial and tax optimisation.
organisations.pt: Fintech portuguesa fundada em 2024 e sediada em Monchique, que ajuda pequenas empresas nas finanças com algoritmos, IA e uma equipa de consultores. Distinguida como Impact Startup 2025.
organisations.es: Fintech portuguesa fundada en 2024 y con sede en Monchique, que ayuda a las pequeñas empresas con sus finanzas mediante algoritmos, IA y un equipo de consultores. Distinguida como Impact Startup 2025.
organisations.fr: Fintech portugaise fondée en 2024 et basée à Monchique, qui aide les petites entreprises dans leurs finances avec des algorithmes, de l'IA et une équipe de conseillers. Distinguée comme Impact Startup 2025.

organisations.name: IPMA, Estação Piloto de Piscicultura de Olhão (EPPO)
organisations.what: National pilot fish-farming station at Marim in the Ria Formosa Natural Park, for research, pilot-scale demonstration and technology transfer to industry.
organisations.ai: Hosts the lab where AI and digital aquaculture research is tested. Its page mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: Estação piloto nacional de piscicultura em Marim, na Ria Formosa, para investigação, demonstração à escala piloto e transferência de tecnologia para a indústria.
organisations.es: Estación piloto nacional de piscicultura en Marim, en la Ria Formosa, para investigación, demostración a escala piloto y transferencia de tecnología a la industria.
organisations.fr: Station pilote nationale de pisciculture à Marim, dans la Ria Formosa, pour la recherche, la démonstration à l'échelle pilote et le transfert de technologie vers l'industrie.

organisations.name: ISMAT, Instituto Superior Manuel Teixeira Gomes
organisations.what: Higher-education institution in Portimão run by COFAC. Its computer engineering degree has a 6 ECTS Inteligência Artificial unit in the third year.
organisations.ai: Teaches AI as part of a computing degree.
organisations.pt: Instituição de ensino superior em Portimão, gerida pela COFAC. A licenciatura em engenharia informática tem uma unidade de Inteligência Artificial no terceiro ano.
organisations.es: Institución de enseñanza superior en Portimão, gestionada por COFAC. El grado en ingeniería informática tiene una asignatura de Inteligencia Artificial en tercer curso.
organisations.fr: Établissement d'enseignement supérieur à Portimão, géré par la COFAC. La licence en génie informatique comprend une unité d'intelligence artificielle en troisième année.

organisations.name: JFA Training
organisations.what: Training and consulting firm applying the Kaizen method, listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator. Two speakers from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.
organisations.ai: A training firm from the incubator that spoke on a local AI panel.
organisations.pt: Empresa de formação e consultoria com o método Kaizen, listada na incubadora StartUP Portimão.
organisations.es: Empresa de formación y consultoría con el método Kaizen, que figura en la incubadora StartUP Portimão.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de formation et de conseil selon la méthode Kaizen, répertoriée à l'incubateur StartUP Portimão.

organisations.name: Junior Achievement Portugal
organisations.what: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

partner.note: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

organisations.pt: Dinamiza o programa 'A Empresa' no trabalho de educação da Algarve Evolution.
organisations.es: Impulsa el programa 'A Empresa' en el trabajo educativo de Algarve Evolution.
organisations.fr: Anime le programme 'A Empresa' dans le travail éducatif d'Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Aljezur
organisations.what: The parish council that launched the Gota Aljezur teleassistance pilot with Tecnologias Imaginadas.
organisations.ai: A public body adopting health technology, a first step toward AI services.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia que lançou o piloto de teleassistência Gota Aljezur com a Tecnologias Imaginadas.
organisations.es: La junta de parroquia que lanzó el piloto de teleasistencia Gota Aljezur con Tecnologias Imaginadas.
organisations.fr: Le conseil de paroisse qui a lancé le pilote de téléassistance Gota Aljezur avec Tecnologias Imaginadas.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Ferragudo
organisations.what: The parish council runs Ferrukas, an AI virtual assistant on its website, and an official app. A PRR-funded digital neighbourhood project is under way in the village.
organisations.ai: Operates an AI assistant for citizens.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia tem a Ferrukas, uma assistente virtual com IA no seu site, e uma aplicação oficial.
organisations.es: La junta de parroquia tiene a Ferrukas, una asistente virtual con IA en su web, y una aplicación oficial.
organisations.fr: Le conseil de paroisse dispose de Ferrukas, une assistante virtuelle avec IA sur son site, et d'une application officielle.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Quarteira
organisations.what: The parish council of Quarteira, a partner in the digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia de Quarteira, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital.
organisations.es: La junta de parroquia de Quarteira, socia del consorcio del barrio comercial digital.
organisations.fr: Le conseil de paroisse de Quarteira, partenaire du consortium du quartier commerçant numérique.

organisations.name: Jupiter Hotel Group (Jupiter Albufeira Hotel)
organisations.what: A hotel group with a hotel in Albufeira that the vendor Quinta lists as a user of its AI guest communication app.
organisations.ai: Hotel group uses an AI guest-messaging app, named by the vendor.
organisations.pt: Grupo hoteleiro com um hotel em Albufeira que o fornecedor Quinta indica como utilizador da sua aplicação de comunicação com hóspedes com IA.
organisations.es: Grupo hotelero con un hotel en Albufeira que el proveedor Quinta señala como usuario de su aplicación de comunicación con huéspedes con IA.
organisations.fr: Groupe hôtelier avec un hôtel à Albufeira que le fournisseur Quinta cite comme utilisateur de son application de communication avec les clients avec IA.

organisations.name: KIPT CoLab
organisations.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.
organisations.ai: It is a partner of the AI and robotics tourism programme.
organisations.pt: Parceiro do consórcio INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. O seu papel na IA ainda não tem fonte.
organisations.es: Socio del consorcio INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Su papel en la IA aún no tiene fuente.
organisations.fr: Partenaire du consortium INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Son rôle dans l'IA n'a pas encore de source.

organisations.name: KTTSeaDrones (cross-border Spain and Portugal project, with a Sagres pilot)
organisations.what: A POCTEP research project on aerial and aquatic drones and fixed sensors for marine and fisheries science, led by the Universidad de Huelva, with CCMAR and CINTAL as Algarve partners and a pilot at Sagres. A search result describing its technical report says its software layer used computer vision and AI to detect fish. We could not open the report (it returned errors), so the AI claim is unverified.
organisations.ai: Reported by a search summary of the project's technical report: computer vision and AI models to identify fish in video. To be confirmed by opening the report. Path: marine monitoring project, then its fish detection software, which is AI.
organisations.pt: Projeto de investigação POCTEP sobre drones aéreos e aquáticos e sensores para a ciência marinha e das pescas, liderado pela Universidad de Huelva, com o CCMAR e o CINTAL como parceiros no Algarve e um piloto em Sagres.
organisations.es: Proyecto de investigación POCTEP sobre drones aéreos y acuáticos y sensores para la ciencia marina y pesquera, liderado por la Universidad de Huelva, con el CCMAR y el CINTAL como socios en el Algarve y un piloto en Sagres.
organisations.fr: Projet de recherche POCTEP sur les drones aériens et aquatiques et les capteurs pour les sciences marines et halieutiques, mené par l'Universidad de Huelva, avec le CCMAR et le CINTAL comme partenaires en Algarve et un pilote à Sagres.

organisations.name: Lagos Digital Nomads
organisations.what: Started by a local entrepreneur in 2020 or 2021 during the pandemic, it links the town's digital nomads with local businesses through a website, networking events and workshops. Media partner of the Women's Day AI event.
organisations.ai: Media partner of an AI event, and a community of remote workers who are a likely audience for AI tools.
organisations.pt: Criada por um empresário local durante a pandemia, liga os nómadas digitais da cidade às empresas locais com um site, eventos e workshops.
organisations.es: Creada por un empresario local durante la pandemia, conecta a los nómadas digitales de la ciudad con las empresas locales mediante una web, eventos y talleres.
organisations.fr: Créée par un entrepreneur local pendant la pandémie, elle relie les nomades numériques de la ville aux entreprises locales avec un site, des événements et des ateliers.

organisations.name: Lagos Remoters
organisations.what: A community of Lagos remote workers, listed as a partner and media partner of the International Women's Day Build with AI event.
organisations.ai: Partner of an AI and business event, and a pool of remote workers who attend such events.
organisations.pt: Uma comunidade de trabalhadores remotos de Lagos, parceira do evento Build with AI do Dia Internacional da Mulher.
organisations.es: Una comunidad de trabajadores en remoto de Lagos, socia del evento Build with AI del Día Internacional de la Mujer.
organisations.fr: Une communauté de travailleurs à distance de Lagos, partenaire de l'événement Build with AI de la Journée internationale des femmes.

organisations.name: LeiGPT
organisations.what: AI platform for lawyers on Portuguese law, registered in Faro and a member of Algarve Evolution, which its site lists with Google for Startups and Akamai among its partners and supporters. It answers legal research questions with citations to codes and court rulings, analyses documents, and runs as a cloud service or on a client's own servers. Available now, with a free one-day trial.
organisations.ai: Its product is an AI assistant for legal work.
organisations.pt: Plataforma de IA para advogados sobre direito português, registada em Faro e membro da Algarve Evolution, cujo site indica a Google for Startups e a Akamai entre os seus parceiros e apoiantes. Responde a perguntas de pesquisa jurídica com citações de códigos e decisões judiciais, analisa documentos e funciona como serviço na nuvem ou nos servidores do próprio cliente. Já disponível, com um dia de teste gratuito.
organisations.es: Plataforma de IA para abogados sobre derecho portugués, registrada en Faro y miembro de Algarve Evolution, cuya web cita a Google for Startups y Akamai entre sus socios y apoyos. Responde a preguntas de investigación jurídica con citas de códigos y resoluciones judiciales, analiza documentos y funciona como servicio en la nube o en los servidores del propio cliente. Ya disponible, con un día de prueba gratuita.
organisations.fr: Plateforme d'IA pour avocats sur le droit portugais, enregistrée à Faro et membre d'Algarve Evolution, dont le site cite Google for Startups et Akamai parmi ses partenaires et soutiens. Elle répond aux questions de recherche juridique avec des citations de codes et de décisions de justice, analyse des documents et fonctionne comme service dans le cloud ou sur les serveurs du client. Déjà disponible, avec une journée d'essai gratuit.

organisations.name: Liceu Azul
organisations.what: New school project in Aljezur with secondary education in Sciences and Technologies, due to open in September 2026, with a research centre on innovative teaching.
organisations.ai: Science and technology education is the start of a local pipeline toward AI skills. No AI teaching is claimed.
organisations.pt: Novo projeto de escola em Aljezur com ensino secundário em Ciências e Tecnologias, com abertura prevista para setembro de 2026.
organisations.es: Nuevo proyecto de escuela en Aljezur con bachillerato de Ciencias y Tecnologías, con apertura prevista para septiembre de 2026.
organisations.fr: Nouveau projet d'école à Aljezur avec un enseignement secondaire en sciences et technologies, dont l'ouverture est prévue en septembre 2026.

organisations.name: LOFT Community
organisations.what: Community of remote workers, digital nomads and entrepreneurs across Loulé, Olhão, Faro and Tavira. Its collaborators include Algarve Evolution, Tavira Works, GDG, the Algarve Blockchain Community, GeekSessions and the 351 Startup Association. No AI event is listed on its page.
organisations.ai: A tech-adjacent community whose collaborators run developer and startup events where AI is a topic. The page lists no AI-specific event.
organisations.pt: Comunidade de trabalhadores remotos, nómadas digitais e empreendedores em Loulé, Olhão, Faro e Tavira. Entre os colaboradores estão a Algarve Evolution, a Tavira Works, o GDG, a Algarve Blockchain Community, as GeekSessions e a 351 Startup Association. A sua página não lista eventos de IA.
organisations.es: Comunidad de trabajadores en remoto, nómadas digitales y emprendedores en Loulé, Olhão, Faro y Tavira. Entre sus colaboradores están Algarve Evolution, Tavira Works, el GDG, Algarve Blockchain Community, GeekSessions y 351 Startup Association. Su página no recoge eventos de IA.
organisations.fr: Communauté de travailleurs à distance, de nomades numériques et d'entrepreneurs à Loulé, Olhão, Faro et Tavira. Parmi ses collaborateurs figurent Algarve Evolution, Tavira Works, le GDG, l'Algarve Blockchain Community, les GeekSessions et la 351 Startup Association. Sa page ne mentionne pas d'événements d'IA.

organisations.name: Loulé and Faro multi-technology centre, Estádio Algarve (planned)
organisations.what: A tendered centre of about 2,235 square metres for companies and startups. Proposals were due on 2 November 2026 and the work has 12 months to run.
organisations.pt: Centro em concurso de cerca de 2.235 metros quadrados para empresas e startups. As propostas terminaram a 2 de novembro de 2026 e a obra tem 12 meses.
organisations.es: Centro en licitación de unos 2.235 metros cuadrados para empresas y startups. Las ofertas se cerraron el 2 de noviembre de 2026 y la obra dura 12 meses.
organisations.fr: Centre en appel d'offres d'environ 2 235 mètres carrés pour des entreprises et des start-up. Les offres ont été closes le 2 novembre 2026 et les travaux durent 12 mois.

organisations.name: Loulé Concelho Global
organisations.what: Named as a partner in the Quarteira digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Parceiro do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.es: Socio del consorcio del barrio comercial digital de Quarteira.
organisations.fr: Partenaire du consortium du quartier commerçant numérique de Quarteira.

organisations.name: Loulé Design Lab (Loulé Criativo)
organisations.what: Municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI programme found yet.
organisations.ai: A municipal incubator where AI startups could land: the lab, then its startups.

also.what: The municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space.

organisations.pt: Incubadora municipal criativa e tecnológica e espaço de coworking, segundo o BeAlgarve.
organisations.es: Incubadora municipal creativa y tecnológica y espacio de coworking, según BeAlgarve.
organisations.fr: Incubateur municipal créatif et technologique et espace de coworking, selon BeAlgarve.

organisations.name: Lovable
organisations.what: AI app-building company whose tool powered the sold-out Vibathon Algarve of 31 October 2026, co-organised with Algarve Evolution (per our newsroom).
organisations.ai: Its AI tool was the core of the event.
organisations.pt: Empresa de criação de aplicações com IA cuja ferramenta foi usada no Vibathon Algarve, esgotado, a 31 de outubro de 2026, coorganizado com a Algarve Evolution.
organisations.es: Empresa de creación de aplicaciones con IA cuya herramienta se usó en el Vibathon Algarve, con las plazas agotadas, el 31 de octubre de 2026, coorganizado con Algarve Evolution.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de création d'applications avec IA dont l'outil a servi au Vibathon Algarve, complet, le 31 octobre 2026, coorganisé avec Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: MARREAL underwater observatory, Sagres (UAlg, CINTAL, CCMAR, INESC-TEC)
organisations.what: An observatory installed in October 2022 at about 20 metres depth off Sagres, with an underwater video camera, a temperature and salinity sensor, a particle sensor and an underwater noise sensor. It records data in real time, to be put online. An initiative of the Tec4Sea research infrastructure, with the KTTSeaDrones project joining.
organisations.ai: Video and acoustic data streams are the raw material for automatic detection of fish and sounds. The article itself does not mention AI, so the link is unconfirmed. Path: ocean observatory, then its video and sound data, then AI analysis.
organisations.pt: Observatório instalado em outubro de 2022 a cerca de 20 metros de profundidade ao largo de Sagres, com câmara de vídeo e sensores, que regista dados em tempo real.
organisations.es: Observatorio instalado en octubre de 2022 a unos 20 metros de profundidad frente a Sagres, con cámara de vídeo y sensores, que registra datos en tiempo real.
organisations.fr: Observatoire installé en octobre 2022 à environ 20 mètres de profondeur au large de Sagres, avec une caméra vidéo et des capteurs, qui enregistre des données en temps réel.

organisations.name: Mentors and partner network of StartUP Portimão
organisations.what: In 2022 the incubator reported more than 40 mentors, more than 45 partner entities and 25 startups hosted. Its site has sections for national and local partners, an advisory board and mentors.
organisations.pt: Em 2022 a incubadora indicava mais de 40 mentores, mais de 45 entidades parceiras e 25 startups acolhidas.
organisations.es: En 2022 la incubadora indicaba más de 40 mentores, más de 45 entidades socias y 25 startups acogidas.
organisations.fr: En 2022, l'incubateur annonçait plus de 40 mentors, plus de 45 organismes partenaires et 25 start-up accueillies.

organisations.name: Mind (ePaper)
organisations.what: Portuguese software vendor whose ePaper urban planning system is going into Castro Marim. It also markets an AI agent, Agente ePaper IA, that answers planning questions in natural language, reported on its own news page on 13 October 2026.
organisations.ai: Vendor of an AI agent product and of the AI-ready software the council is adopting. Not based in Castro Marim as far as we saw, listed because it supplies the town.
organisations.pt: Empresa portuguesa de software cujo sistema de urbanismo ePaper está a ser implementado em Castro Marim. Também comercializa um agente de IA que responde a perguntas de urbanismo.
organisations.es: Empresa portuguesa de software cuyo sistema de urbanismo ePaper se está implantando en Castro Marim. También comercializa un agente de IA que responde a preguntas de urbanismo.
organisations.fr: Entreprise portugaise de logiciels dont le système d'urbanisme ePaper est en cours de déploiement à Castro Marim. Elle commercialise aussi un agent d'IA qui répond aux questions d'urbanisme.

organisations.name: Modernizacao e Digitalizacao do Municipio de Alcoutim (Algarve 2030 project)
organisations.what: Council project to strengthen IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, digitise internal processes, open online services and train staff, due 30 June 2028.
organisations.ai: Digital records and online services are the groundwork for any later AI in the council's services. No AI is mentioned.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara para reforçar a infraestrutura informática e a cibersegurança, digitalizar processos internos, abrir serviços online e formar trabalhadores, com conclusão prevista a 30 de junho de 2028.
organisations.es: Proyecto del ayuntamiento para reforzar la infraestructura informática y la ciberseguridad, digitalizar procesos internos, abrir servicios en línea y formar al personal, con finalización prevista el 30 de junio de 2028.
organisations.fr: Projet de la mairie pour renforcer l'infrastructure informatique et la cybersécurité, numériser les processus internes, ouvrir des services en ligne et former le personnel, dont l'achèvement est prévu le 30 juin 2028.

organisations.name: MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
organisations.what: UAlg spin-off founded in October 2019 and based at UALG TEC Campus. Sensors and a web app switch off hotel room air conditioning when a window opens or a room is empty. Backed by Portugal Ventures.
organisations.ai: Its origin was a research project using AI algorithms, but the 2022 article does not say how the product uses AI now.
organisations.pt: Spin-off da UAlg fundada em 2019 e sediada no UALG TEC Campus. Sensores e uma aplicação web desligam o ar condicionado dos quartos de hotel quando uma janela abre ou o quarto está vazio.
organisations.es: Spin-off de la UAlg fundada en 2019 y con sede en el UALG TEC Campus. Sensores y una aplicación web apagan el aire acondicionado de las habitaciones de hotel cuando se abre una ventana o la habitación está vacía.
organisations.fr: Spin-off de l'UAlg fondée en 2019 et basée au UALG TEC Campus. Des capteurs et une application web coupent la climatisation des chambres d'hôtel quand une fenêtre s'ouvre ou que la chambre est vide.

organisations.name: Municipal tax exemptions for innovative or creative investment
organisations.what: The council says it has granted tax exemptions since at least mid-2017 to investment projects such as innovative or creative activities, job creation, local products and energy efficiency.
organisations.pt: A câmara diz que concede isenções fiscais desde pelo menos meados de 2017 a projetos de investimento como atividades inovadoras ou criativas, criação de emprego, produtos locais e eficiência energética.
organisations.es: El ayuntamiento dice que concede exenciones fiscales desde al menos mediados de 2017 a proyectos de inversión como actividades innovadoras o creativas, creación de empleo, productos locales y eficiencia energética.
organisations.fr: La mairie dit accorder depuis au moins mi-2017 des exonérations fiscales à des projets d'investissement comme les activités innovantes ou créatives, la création d'emplois, les produits locaux et l'efficacité énergétique.

organisations.name: Município de Albufeira
organisations.what: The council says it uses an AI-based urban management platform, and it runs a smart city portal for occurrence management.
organisations.ai: The council says it uses AI in urban processes.
organisations.pt: A câmara diz usar uma plataforma de gestão urbana com IA e tem um portal de cidade inteligente para gestão de ocorrências.
organisations.es: El ayuntamiento dice usar una plataforma de gestión urbana con IA y tiene un portal de ciudad inteligente para la gestión de incidencias.
organisations.fr: La mairie dit utiliser une plateforme de gestion urbaine avec IA et dispose d'un portail de ville intelligente pour la gestion des signalements.

organisations.name: Municipio de Alcoutim
organisations.what: The council's published general office channel and opening hours.

contacts.label: Municipio de Alcoutim: official general channel
contacts.channel: The council's general email and telephone, with opening hours Monday to Friday 8:30 to 15:00, are published in the footer of the linked page. Shown here as a link, not copied: the gate still rejects a literal address.

organisations.pt: Os contactos gerais publicados pela câmara e o horário de atendimento.
organisations.es: Los contactos generales que publica el ayuntamiento y el horario de atención.
organisations.fr: Les coordonnées générales publiées par la mairie et les horaires d'accueil.

organisations.name: Municipio de Aljezur
organisations.what: The council runs an online services portal, an interactive municipal map, a GEO Portal and a tourist app. We found no AI use.
organisations.ai: Digital services and geodata are the base on which AI assistants and analysis would sit. Nothing AI found yet.

contacts.label: Município de Aljezur, general channel (Contactos úteis page)
contacts.channel: geral@cm-aljezur.pt, +351 282 990 010 (a call to the national fixed-line network), as published on the council's Contactos úteis page. Paços do Concelho, Rua Capitão Salgueiro Maia, 8670-005 Aljezur.

organisations.pt: A câmara tem um portal de serviços online, um mapa municipal interativo, um GEO Portal e uma aplicação turística. Não encontrámos uso de IA.
organisations.es: El ayuntamiento tiene un portal de servicios en línea, un mapa municipal interactivo, un GEO Portal y una aplicación turística. No encontramos uso de IA.
organisations.fr: La mairie dispose d'un portail de services en ligne, d'une carte municipale interactive, d'un GEO Portal et d'une application touristique. Nous n'avons pas trouvé d'usage de l'IA.

organisations.name: Município de Lagoa, SmartCity:Lagoa
organisations.what: The council runs a Smart City portal and an AI air quality prototype built with a polytechnic student, and its IT coordinator has spoken publicly about AI limits in local government.
organisations.ai: Uses an AI model for air quality forecasts.
organisations.pt: A câmara tem um portal Smart City e um protótipo de qualidade do ar com IA criado com um estudante do politécnico.
organisations.es: El ayuntamiento tiene un portal Smart City y un prototipo de calidad del aire con IA creado con un estudiante del politécnico.
organisations.fr: La mairie dispose d'un portail Smart City et d'un prototype de qualité de l'air avec IA créé avec un étudiant de l'institut polytechnique.

organisations.name: Município de São Brás de Alportel
organisations.what: Local council, partner in the Algarve 6.0 smart territory project, supporter of University of Algarve research, host of the town's entrepreneurship programme.
organisations.ai: Runs the urban management platform data base and funded an AI workshop.
organisations.pt: Câmara municipal, parceira do projeto de território inteligente Algarve 6.0, apoiante da investigação da Universidade do Algarve e anfitriã do programa de empreendedorismo local.
organisations.es: Ayuntamiento, socio del proyecto de territorio inteligente Algarve 6.0, que apoya la investigación de la Universidad del Algarve y acoge el programa de emprendimiento local.
organisations.fr: Mairie, partenaire du projet de territoire intelligent Algarve 6.0, qui soutient la recherche de l'Université de l'Algarve et accueille le programme local d'entrepreneuriat.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, digitalisation of municipal services
organisations.what: The council's own project sheet (approved 9 October 2025, running 1 July 2022 to 31 December 2027): strengthen the technology and network infrastructure for more capacity and reliability, described as technological modernisation and digital transformation of local administration. Eligible cost 1,072,637.94 euros, EU support 643,582.75 euros.
organisations.ai: Not AI itself. A council's digital backbone is what any later AI service for residents would run on. Path: municipal network and digital services, then AI services on top. No AI use is stated.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara (2022 a 2027) para reforçar a infraestrutura tecnológica e de rede, com um custo elegível de 1.072.637,94 euros e apoio europeu de 643.582,75 euros.
organisations.es: Proyecto del ayuntamiento (2022 a 2027) para reforzar la infraestructura tecnológica y de red, con un coste subvencionable de 1.072.637,94 euros y una ayuda europea de 643.582,75 euros.
organisations.fr: Projet de la mairie (2022 à 2027) pour renforcer l'infrastructure technologique et réseau, avec un coût éligible de 1 072 637,94 euros et une aide européenne de 643 582,75 euros.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, smart urban waste management
organisations.what: The council's project sheet (approved 21 November 2025, 1 June 2024 to 31 December 2025): reinforce and optimise separate waste collection, with efficiency, 'intelligent' waste management and bio-waste collection. Eligible cost 439,725 euros, EU support 263,835 euros.
organisations.ai: Weak. The sheet says intelligent management but does not mention AI or sensors. Path: smart waste collection, then data-driven routing, then AI. Unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara (2024 a 2025) para reforçar e otimizar a recolha seletiva de resíduos, com um custo elegível de 439.725 euros e apoio europeu de 263.835 euros.
organisations.es: Proyecto del ayuntamiento (2024 a 2025) para reforzar y optimizar la recogida selectiva de residuos, con un coste subvencionable de 439.725 euros y una ayuda europea de 263.835 euros.
organisations.fr: Projet de la mairie (2024 à 2025) pour renforcer et optimiser la collecte sélective des déchets, avec un coût éligible de 439 725 euros et une aide européenne de 263 835 euros.

organisations.name: Nautiber, Estaleiros Navais do Guadiana
organisations.what: Shipyard on the Guadiana in Vila Real de Santo António. In 2021 it launched the 19 metre research vessel «Mar Profundo» for INESC TEC and CINTAL (University of Algarve), meant for testing marine robots, sensors and unmanned underwater vehicles. In December 2025 it said it plans a defence unit aimed at unmanned systems, with the structure of four surface drones already delivered, and the site undecided between VRSA, Portimão and Lagos. Visited in February 2026 as part of the council's blue economy push.
organisations.ai: It builds the hulls and structures of robots and drones, the platforms on which autonomy and AI run. The articles mention no AI.
organisations.pt: Estaleiro no Guadiana, em Vila Real de Santo António. Em 2021 lançou o navio de investigação «Mar Profundo», de 19 metros, para testar robôs marinhos e veículos subaquáticos.
organisations.es: Astillero en el Guadiana, en Vila Real de Santo António. En 2021 botó el buque de investigación «Mar Profundo», de 19 metros, para probar robots marinos y vehículos submarinos.
organisations.fr: Chantier naval sur le Guadiana, à Vila Real de Santo António. En 2021, il a lancé le navire de recherche « Mar Profundo », de 19 mètres, pour tester des robots marins et des véhicules sous-marins.

organisations.name: Neomarca
organisations.what: SME consultancy operating since 1995 with its head office in Faro and a team in Porto, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its digital transformation work includes a service called digitalisation and adoption of artificial intelligence, alongside funding advice for programmes such as PRR and Portugal 2030.
organisations.ai: It consults small firms on adopting AI tools and on the funding that pays for it.
organisations.pt: Consultora de PME em atividade desde 1995, com sede em Faro e uma equipa no Porto, e membro da Algarve Evolution. O seu trabalho de transformação digital inclui um serviço de digitalização e adoção de inteligência artificial, a par de aconselhamento sobre financiamento de programas como o PRR e o Portugal 2030.
organisations.es: Consultora de pymes en activo desde 1995, con sede en Faro y un equipo en Oporto, y miembro de Algarve Evolution. Su trabajo de transformación digital incluye un servicio de digitalización y adopción de inteligencia artificial, junto con asesoramiento sobre financiación de programas como el PRR y Portugal 2030.
organisations.fr: Cabinet de conseil aux PME en activité depuis 1995, basé à Faro avec une équipe à Porto, et membre d'Algarve Evolution. Son travail de transformation numérique comprend un service de numérisation et d'adoption de l'intelligence artificielle, ainsi que du conseil sur le financement de programmes comme le PRR et Portugal 2030.

organisations.name: NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve
organisations.what: Regional business association headquartered in Loulé. It leads the Inova Algarve 3.0 consortium and runs AI tool training sessions and courses in November 2026.
organisations.ai: It trains firms on AI tools and leads an AI and robotics programme.

also.what: Business support, legal advice, professional training, economic information, a business centre and space rental, and coworking.
Regional business association based in Loulé. Leads INOVA ALGARVE 3.0, runs an AI Social Content Lab course in November 2026 and hosted the AI Lunch & Learn.

contacts.label: NERA, general desk
contacts.channel: nera@nera.pt, phone +351 289 415 151, as published in the footer of nera.pt

partner.note: Business association of the Algarve; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: Associação empresarial regional com sede em Loulé. Lidera o consórcio Inova Algarve 3.0 e organiza sessões de formação e cursos sobre ferramentas de IA em novembro de 2026.
organisations.es: Asociación empresarial regional con sede en Loulé. Lidera el consorcio Inova Algarve 3.0 y organiza sesiones de formación y cursos sobre herramientas de IA en noviembre de 2026.
organisations.fr: Association d'entreprises régionale basée à Loulé. Elle mène le consortium Inova Algarve 3.0 et organise des séances de formation et des cours sur les outils d'IA en novembre 2026.

organisations.name: NILG.AI (partner of ALGAR)
organisations.what: Start-up incubated at UPTEC, the University of Porto's science park, that co-built ALGAR's AI recycling-point tool. Not a Loulé firm: it is listed as ALGAR's partner.
organisations.ai: It builds AI for a Loulé-municipality company.
organisations.pt: Startup incubada no UPTEC, o parque de ciência da Universidade do Porto, que criou com a ALGAR a ferramenta de IA para ecopontos. Não é uma empresa de Loulé.
organisations.es: Startup incubada en UPTEC, el parque científico de la Universidad de Oporto, que creó con ALGAR la herramienta de IA para puntos de reciclaje. No es una empresa de Loulé.
organisations.fr: Start-up incubée à l'UPTEC, le parc scientifique de l'Université de Porto, qui a créé avec ALGAR l'outil d'IA pour les points de tri. Ce n'est pas une entreprise de Loulé.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empreendedorismo 4 Olhos
organisations.what: Second municipal Ninho listed on the council's incubation page, supporting local founders with a space and resources.
organisations.ai: An incubator where AI-using startups could start. No AI use reported.
organisations.pt: Segundo Ninho municipal da página de incubação da câmara, que apoia empreendedores locais com espaço e recursos.
organisations.es: Segundo Ninho municipal de la página de incubación del ayuntamiento, que apoya a los emprendedores locales con espacio y recursos.
organisations.fr: Deuxième Ninho municipal de la page d'incubation de la mairie, qui accompagne les entrepreneurs locaux avec de l'espace et des ressources.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empreendedorismo da Vila
organisations.what: Municipal incubation space in the village square, with one individual office, three coworking desks, two spaces for digital nomads and a meeting room.
organisations.ai: A shared workplace where remote tech workers and local founders could build with AI. No AI use reported.
organisations.pt: Espaço municipal de incubação na praça da vila, com um escritório individual, três postos de coworking, dois espaços para nómadas digitais e uma sala de reuniões.
organisations.es: Espacio municipal de incubación en la plaza del pueblo, con una oficina individual, tres puestos de coworking, dos espacios para nómadas digitales y una sala de reuniones.
organisations.fr: Espace municipal d'incubation sur la place du bourg, avec un bureau individuel, trois postes de coworking, deux espaces pour nomades numériques et une salle de réunion.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empresas de Loulé (IEFP)
organisations.what: Public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI tenants found yet.
organisations.ai: A technology incubator where AI startups could land: the incubator, then its startups.

also.what: A public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve's directory classes it.

organisations.pt: Incubadora pública de empresas e tecnologia, segundo o BeAlgarve.
organisations.es: Incubadora pública de empresas y tecnología, según BeAlgarve.
organisations.fr: Incubateur public d'entreprises et de technologie, selon BeAlgarve.

organisations.name: Nobel Algarve British International School
organisations.what: A school in Lagoa that was the venue and a partner of the Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, a two-day AI hackathon for students aged 12 to 18, on 21 and 22 February 2026.
organisations.ai: Hosted an AI design hackathon for teenagers with Algarve Evolution and Algarve Tech Hub.
organisations.pt: Escola em Lagoa que acolheu o Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, um hackathon de IA de dois dias para alunos dos 12 aos 18 anos, em fevereiro de 2026.
organisations.es: Escuela en Lagoa que acogió el Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, un hackathon de IA de dos días para alumnos de 12 a 18 años, en febrero de 2026.
organisations.fr: École à Lagoa qui a accueilli le Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, un hackathon d'IA de deux jours pour les élèves de 12 à 18 ans, en février 2026.

organisations.name: NOVA IMS and the Lagos council smart cities protocol
organisations.what: A three-year protocol signed in September 2021 for smart-city research and data management. The article does not mention AI.
organisations.ai: Data management and smart-city research is the base for AI services, but no AI is named, so this is context only.
organisations.pt: Protocolo de três anos assinado em setembro de 2021 para investigação em cidades inteligentes e gestão de dados.
organisations.es: Protocolo de tres años firmado en septiembre de 2021 para la investigación en ciudades inteligentes y gestión de datos.
organisations.fr: Protocole de trois ans signé en septembre 2021 pour la recherche sur les villes intelligentes et la gestion des données.

organisations.name: NOVA LINCS, UAlg pole (engineering laboratory, Campus da Penha)
organisations.what: A UAlg research centre in Faro. A November 2025 call for a one-year research grant starting in January 2026 places the work there, on the AI.INSIGHTS project (AI-powered real-time anonymous user monitoring), funded by Algarve FEDER, seeking computer vision and AI skills.
organisations.ai: Runs an AI research project in Faro.
organisations.pt: Um centro de investigação da UAlg em Faro. Um aviso de novembro de 2025 para uma bolsa de investigação de um ano, com início em janeiro de 2026, situa ali o trabalho, no projeto AI.INSIGHTS (monitorização anónima de utilizadores em tempo real com IA), financiado pelo Algarve FEDER, procurando competências em visão computacional e IA.
organisations.es: Un centro de investigación de la UAlg en Faro. Una convocatoria de noviembre de 2025 para una beca de investigación de un año, a partir de enero de 2026, sitúa allí el trabajo, en el proyecto AI.INSIGHTS (seguimiento anónimo de usuarios en tiempo real con IA), financiado por el Algarve FEDER, y busca competencias en visión por ordenador e IA.
organisations.fr: Un centre de recherche de l'UAlg à Faro. Un appel de novembre 2025 pour une bourse de recherche d'un an, à partir de janvier 2026, y situe le travail, dans le projet AI.INSIGHTS (suivi anonyme des utilisateurs en temps réel avec l'IA), financé par l'Algarve FEDER, et cherche des compétences en vision par ordinateur et en IA.

organisations.name: Odiana, Baixo Guadiana development association
organisations.what: Association that represents the Baixo Guadiana in the cooperation network of Agrosocial Plus, a 2,062,429.85 euro Interreg Spain-Portugal project, funded 75 percent by ERDF, whose Living Labs will test AI, IoT and smart irrigation. The article does not say whether Vila Real de Santo António is part of the project.
organisations.ai: Its project tests AI in Living Labs, with the town's link to it unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Associação que representa o Baixo Guadiana na rede de cooperação do Agrosocial Plus, um projeto Interreg Espanha-Portugal de 2.062.429,85 euros, financiado a 75 por cento pelo FEDER, cujos Living Labs vão testar IA, IoT e rega inteligente. O artigo não diz se Vila Real de Santo António faz parte do projeto.
organisations.es: Asociación que representa al Bajo Guadiana en la red de cooperación de Agrosocial Plus, un proyecto Interreg España-Portugal de 2.062.429,85 euros, financiado al 75 por ciento por el FEDER, cuyos Living Labs van a probar IA, IoT y riego inteligente. El artículo no dice si Vila Real de Santo António forma parte del proyecto.
organisations.fr: Association qui représente le Bas Guadiana dans le réseau de coopération d'Agrosocial Plus, un projet Interreg Espagne-Portugal de 2 062 429,85 euros, financé à 75 pour cent par le FEDER, dont les Living Labs vont tester l'IA, l'IoT et l'irrigation intelligente. L'article ne dit pas si Vila Real de Santo António fait partie du projet.

organisations.name: Parkalgar
organisations.what: Manages the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve in Portimão, is a member of the Celerator technology park association with the University of Algarve, and was engaged around the TMCT conference.
organisations.ai: Engaged around a Portimão conference with AI sessions, and part of a technology-park association.
organisations.pt: Gere o Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, em Portimão, e é membro da associação do parque tecnológico Celerator com a Universidade do Algarve.
organisations.es: Gestiona el Autódromo Internacional del Algarve, en Portimão, y es miembro de la asociación del parque tecnológico Celerator con la Universidad del Algarve.
organisations.fr: Gère l'Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, à Portimão, et est membre de l'association du parc technologique Celerator avec l'Université de l'Algarve.

organisations.name: Peanuts
organisations.what: Local marketing and digital content project on the council's entrepreneur showcase (page 4 of 4).
organisations.ai: Digital marketing and content work is where AI writing and image tools are adopted first. The page does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check.
organisations.pt: Projeto local de marketing e conteúdos digitais na montra de empreendedores da câmara.
organisations.es: Proyecto local de marketing y contenidos digitales en el escaparate de emprendedores del ayuntamiento.
organisations.fr: Projet local de marketing et de contenus numériques dans la vitrine des entrepreneurs de la mairie.

organisations.what: A session at StartUP Portimão's ninth anniversary on 10 August 2026 meant to connect entrepreneurs, business people, mentors and potential investors. No investor organisation is named in the report.
organisations.pt: Sessão no nono aniversário da StartUP Portimão, a 10 de agosto de 2026, para ligar empreendedores, empresários, mentores e potenciais investidores.
organisations.es: Sesión en el noveno aniversario de StartUP Portimão, el 10 de agosto de 2026, para conectar a emprendedores, empresarios, mentores y posibles inversores.
organisations.fr: Séance pour le neuvième anniversaire de StartUP Portimão, le 10 août 2026, pour mettre en relation entrepreneurs, chefs d'entreprise, mentors et investisseurs potentiels.

organisations.name: Polo de Inovação de Tavira
organisations.what: Research, innovation and technology-transfer hub on the Mediterranean Diet, health, sustainable food and climate adaptation, funded by the PRR (1.36 million euros, 3 January 2022 to 31 December 2025), with the CCDR Algarve as direct beneficiary. It includes lab equipment and a collection of about 700 fruit and grape varieties. At its November 2021 launch it had 23 partners, among them DRAP Algarve, the Município de Tavira, Ciência Viva, the Algarve Biomedical Center and Johns Hopkins University, and plans for a digital therapeutics centre and virtual-reality training.
organisations.ai: The launch plans include a digital therapeutics centre with Johns Hopkins and the Algarve Biomedical Center, a data-heavy health field where AI is the usual next step. Neither source mentions AI, and whether the centre was built is unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Polo de investigação, inovação e transferência de tecnologia sobre a Dieta Mediterrânica, saúde, alimentação sustentável e adaptação climática, financiado pelo PRR (1,36 milhões de euros, de 3 de janeiro de 2022 a 31 de dezembro de 2025), com a CCDR Algarve como beneficiária direta. Inclui equipamento de laboratório e uma coleção de cerca de 700 variedades de fruta e uva.
organisations.es: Polo de investigación, innovación y transferencia de tecnología sobre la Dieta Mediterránea, la salud, la alimentación sostenible y la adaptación climática, financiado por el PRR (1,36 millones de euros, del 3 de enero de 2022 al 31 de diciembre de 2025), con la CCDR Algarve como beneficiaria directa. Incluye equipamiento de laboratorio y una colección de unas 700 variedades de fruta y uva.
organisations.fr: Pôle de recherche, d'innovation et de transfert de technologie sur le régime méditerranéen, la santé, l'alimentation durable et l'adaptation climatique, financé par le PRR (1,36 million d'euros, du 3 janvier 2022 au 31 décembre 2025), avec la CCDR Algarve comme bénéficiaire directe. Il comprend des équipements de laboratoire et une collection d'environ 700 variétés de fruits et de raisins.

organisations.name: Portugal Ventures into MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
organisations.what: Invested more than half a million euros in MTI, a UAlg spin-off at UALG TEC Campus that automates hotel air conditioning. The source ties the original research to AI (genetic algorithms) but does not say how the product uses AI today.
organisations.ai: A UAlg spin-off whose research project used AI algorithms: one step from AI.
organisations.pt: Investiu mais de meio milhão de euros na MTI, spin-off da UAlg no UALG TEC Campus que automatiza o ar condicionado de hotéis.
organisations.es: Invirtió más de medio millón de euros en MTI, spin-off de la UAlg en el UALG TEC Campus que automatiza el aire acondicionado de hoteles.
organisations.fr: A investi plus d'un demi-million d'euros dans MTI, spin-off de l'UAlg au UALG TEC Campus qui automatise la climatisation des hôtels.

organisations.name: PRR funding for the Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub
organisations.what: Non-refundable PRR funding for the six-municipality sensor and data platform.
organisations.ai: A sensor and data platform is the base for analytics and AI. The project page does not mention AI.

organisations.es: Financiación PRR a fondo perdido para la plataforma de sensores y datos de los seis municipios.

organisations.ai: Funds AI training for healthcare leaders: directly about AI.
