organisations.es: Fondos del Plan de Recuperación pagaron la matrícula completa de participantes seleccionados del curso ejecutivo de IA en la salud de abril de 2026.
organisations.fr: Des fonds du Plan de relance ont payé l'intégralité des frais d'inscription de participants sélectionnés au cours pour cadres sur l'IA en santé d'avril 2026.

organisations.name: Quarteira Lab (Câmara Municipal de Loulé, with Fundo Ambiental)
organisations.what: A decarbonisation living lab around Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, co-financed by the Fundo Ambiental, with a people and bicycle counter feeding a data platform.
organisations.ai: Sensors and a data platform in the street: a base for analytics, no AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Laboratório vivo de descarbonização em torno da Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, cofinanciado pelo Fundo Ambiental, com um contador de pessoas e bicicletas ligado a uma plataforma de dados.
organisations.es: Laboratorio vivo de descarbonización en torno a la Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, cofinanciado por el Fondo Ambiental, con un contador de personas y bicicletas conectado a una plataforma de datos.
organisations.fr: Laboratoire vivant de décarbonation autour de l'Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, cofinancé par le Fonds environnemental, avec un compteur de personnes et de vélos relié à une plateforme de données.

organisations.name: Radar Social (PRR pilot, Alcoutim council)
organisations.what: A PRR-funded social response with a two-person team and 169,302.59 euros. Its second phase, due to run to March 2026, sets up a social georeferencing system to locate people and families at risk and the resources around them.
organisations.ai: A georeferenced map of people at risk is the dataset on which AI risk-flagging could be built. The article names no software and does not mention AI.
organisations.pt: Resposta social financiada pelo PRR, com uma equipa de duas pessoas, que cria um sistema de georreferenciação social para localizar pessoas e famílias em risco.
organisations.es: Respuesta social financiada por el PRR, con un equipo de dos personas, que crea un sistema de georreferenciación social para localizar a personas y familias en riesgo.
organisations.fr: Réponse sociale financée par le PRR, avec une équipe de deux personnes, qui crée un système de géoréférencement social pour repérer les personnes et les familles en difficulté.

organisations.name: Re-Source 3.0 (Sociedade Ponto Verde) behind ALGAR's AI tool
organisations.what: The programme under which ALGAR and NILG.AI built the AI recycling-point tool. One report puts the investment at 50 thousand euros.
organisations.ai: The programme funded an AI tool for a Loulé-municipality company.
organisations.pt: O programa no âmbito do qual a ALGAR e a NILG.AI criaram a ferramenta de IA para ecopontos.
organisations.es: El programa en el marco del cual ALGAR y NILG.AI crearon la herramienta de IA para puntos de reciclaje.
organisations.fr: Le programme dans le cadre duquel ALGAR et NILG.AI ont créé l'outil d'IA pour les points de tri.

organisations.name: REAVER (PRR, Municipio de Alcoutim as beneficiary)
organisations.what: A council project on how sustainable forest production and agroforestry can reverse desertification and the effects of depopulation, by quantifying the value of ecosystem services. 124,800 euros of EU support, 6 September 2022 to 31 December 2025.
organisations.ai: Quantifying ecosystem services and land change is data and modelling work, a third-step base for AI. The sheet mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: Um projeto da câmara sobre a forma como a produção florestal sustentável e a agrofloresta podem inverter a desertificação e os efeitos do despovoamento, quantificando o valor dos serviços dos ecossistemas. 124.800 euros de apoio europeu, de 6 de setembro de 2022 a 31 de dezembro de 2025.
organisations.es: Un proyecto del ayuntamiento sobre cómo la producción forestal sostenible y la agroforestería pueden invertir la desertificación y los efectos de la despoblación, cuantificando el valor de los servicios de los ecosistemas. 124.800 euros de ayuda europea, del 6 de septiembre de 2022 al 31 de diciembre de 2025.
organisations.fr: Un projet de la mairie sur la façon dont la production forestière durable et l'agroforesterie peuvent inverser la désertification et les effets du dépeuplement, en chiffrant la valeur des services écosystémiques. 124 800 euros d'aide européenne, du 6 septembre 2022 au 31 décembre 2025.

organisations.name: Regional funding call for the UAlg technology campus
organisations.what: A call of 10 million euros at 60% funding, with the application to ALGARVE 2030 expected around February 2025, for a campus whose focus areas are digital, data and AI. Funding was not fully secured at the time of the report.
organisations.ai: Funds a campus whose stated focus includes AI.
organisations.amount: 10 million euros available in the call
organisations.pt: Aviso de 10 milhões de euros com 60% de financiamento, para um campus dedicado ao digital, aos dados e à IA. O financiamento não estava garantido à data da notícia.
organisations.es: Convocatoria de 10 millones de euros con un 60% de financiación, para un campus dedicado a lo digital, los datos y la IA. La financiación no estaba garantizada en la fecha de la noticia.
organisations.fr: Appel de 10 millions d'euros avec 60 % de financement, pour un campus consacré au numérique, aux données et à l'IA. Le financement n'était pas garanti à la date de l'article.

organisations.name: Robotics4Farmers (PRR agenda, with Municipio de Alcoutim as a named partner)
organisations.what: An 11-partner consortium building collaborative, intelligent, eco-efficient farm robots, first for vines, olives and almonds, with a herbicide-free solar-heat weeding platform. The council's own project sheet lists the Municipio de Alcoutim among the beneficiaries and gives the region of intervention as Portugal (Alcoutim). It ran from 1 May 2022 to 30 September 2025 with 117,760.56 euros of EU support. The project page names Instituto Superior Tecnico, the desertification centre and an Elvas olive growers association among its partners.
organisations.ai: The project page says it uses learning algorithms to classify weeds, seasonal prediction models and AI-guided cameras, so it is directly about AI. Alcoutim's council is a beneficiary and the sheet places the intervention in Alcoutim. The sheet does not say what was tested there.
organisations.pt: Consórcio de 11 parceiros que constrói uma plataforma robótica para controlar ervas daninhas sem herbicidas, com calor solar concentrado. A Câmara de Alcoutim é uma das parceiras.
organisations.es: Consorcio de 11 socios que construye una plataforma robótica para controlar malas hierbas sin herbicidas, con calor solar concentrado. El Ayuntamiento de Alcoutim es uno de los socios.
organisations.fr: Consortium de 11 partenaires qui construit une plateforme robotique pour lutter contre les mauvaises herbes sans herbicides, avec de la chaleur solaire concentrée. La mairie d'Alcoutim est l'un des partenaires.

organisations.name: S2AQUAcoLAB
organisations.what: Collaborative laboratory for sustainable and smart aquaculture, founded in 2021 and based in Olhão. It lists technological developments, from robotics to AI, among its research lines, and leads DigiATLA.
organisations.ai: Names AI as a research line (2022 report); leads digital aquaculture work.
organisations.pt: Laboratório colaborativo de aquacultura sustentável e inteligente, fundado em 2021 e sediado em Olhão, com a robótica e a IA entre as suas linhas de investigação.
organisations.es: Laboratorio colaborativo de acuicultura sostenible e inteligente, fundado en 2021 y con sede en Olhão, con la robótica y la IA entre sus líneas de investigación.
organisations.fr: Laboratoire collaboratif d'aquaculture durable et intelligente, fondé en 2021 et basé à Olhão, avec la robotique et l'IA parmi ses axes de recherche.

organisations.name: SalOS
organisations.what: Traceability and operations platform for artisanal salt producers, born inside the Sapal de Castro Marim reserve, with a free 30 day trial. Press describes a digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool.
organisations.ai: Ships a product with an AI assistant, per press.
organisations.pt: Plataforma de rastreabilidade e operações para produtores de sal artesanal, nascida na reserva do Sapal de Castro Marim, com 30 dias de experiência gratuita.
organisations.es: Plataforma de trazabilidad y operaciones para productores de sal artesanal, nacida en la reserva del Sapal de Castro Marim, con 30 días de prueba gratuita.
organisations.fr: Plateforme de traçabilité et d'exploitation pour les producteurs de sel artisanal, née dans la réserve du Sapal de Castro Marim, avec 30 jours d'essai gratuit.

organisations.name: Savvy Alpha
organisations.what: Local business in medical equipment and technology, presented at the council's sixth business ideas forum on 27 October 2026.
organisations.ai: Medical technology is a field where AI is common. The council page gives no product detail and does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check.
organisations.pt: Empresa local de equipamentos e tecnologia médica, apresentada no sexto fórum de ideias de negócio da câmara, a 27 de outubro de 2026.
organisations.es: Empresa local de equipos y tecnología médica, presentada en el sexto foro de ideas de negocio del ayuntamiento, el 27 de octubre de 2026.
organisations.fr: Entreprise locale d'équipements et de technologie médicale, présentée au sixième forum d'idées d'entreprise de la mairie, le 27 octobre 2026.

organisations.name: Sea4Us
organisations.what: Marine biotechnology company in Sagres that develops drugs from marine compounds, led by a chronic pain candidate called Sea4Pain. Spin-off of Nova Medical School, working from Porto da Baleeira.
organisations.ai: Candidate only. Drug discovery is a field where AI is widely used, but neither source we opened says Sea4Us uses AI. Path: marine biotech, then computational drug discovery, then AI. Unconfirmed, to check with the company's own pages.
organisations.pt: Empresa de biotecnologia marinha em Sagres que desenvolve medicamentos a partir de compostos marinhos. Spin-off da Nova Medical School, no Porto da Baleeira.
organisations.es: Empresa de biotecnología marina en Sagres que desarrolla medicamentos a partir de compuestos marinos. Spin-off de la Nova Medical School, en el Porto da Baleeira.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de biotechnologie marine à Sagres qui développe des médicaments à partir de composés marins. Spin-off de la Nova Medical School, au Porto da Baleeira.

organisations.name: SheSapiens
organisations.what: A women's community that ran an AI productivity workshop in Lagos on 14 October 2026 and was a partner of the 2025 International Women's Day Build with AI evening in the Lagos Town Hall.
organisations.ai: Runs AI workshops in Lagos.
organisations.pt: Uma comunidade de mulheres que realizou um workshop de produtividade com IA em Lagos, a 14 de outubro de 2026, e foi parceira da noite Build with AI do Dia Internacional da Mulher de 2025, nos Paços do Concelho de Lagos.
organisations.es: Una comunidad de mujeres que hizo un taller de productividad con IA en Lagos, el 14 de octubre de 2026, y fue socia de la noche Build with AI del Día Internacional de la Mujer de 2025, en el ayuntamiento de Lagos.
organisations.fr: Une communauté de femmes qui a tenu un atelier de productivité avec l'IA à Lagos, le 14 octobre 2026, et a été partenaire de la soirée Build with AI de la Journée internationale des femmes 2025, à l'hôtel de ville de Lagos.

organisations.name: Sociedade da Água de Monchique (Água Monchique)
organisations.what: Mineral water producer with its plant at Caldas de Monchique. Its own pages describe a digital strategy, the myMonchique app, a smart water dispenser shown in 2021 and an automated logistics centre. It states it already uses some AI tools, unspecified.
organisations.ai: Company statement that it uses AI tools in its operations, so AI is direct but unspecified and self-reported.
organisations.pt: Produtora de água mineral com fábrica nas Caldas de Monchique, com uma estratégia digital, a aplicação myMonchique e um centro logístico automatizado.
organisations.es: Productora de agua mineral con fábrica en las Caldas de Monchique, con una estrategia digital, la aplicación myMonchique y un centro logístico automatizado.
organisations.fr: Producteur d'eau minérale avec une usine aux Caldas de Monchique, une stratégie numérique, l'application myMonchique et un centre logistique automatisé.

organisations.name: SPAROS Lda
organisations.what: Aquafeed company in Olhão with a PRR-funded project, IA@SPAROS, to bring AI tools into feed production and into decisions on data, science and administration.
organisations.ai: Its own PRR project adds AI to production and decision support.
organisations.pt: Empresa de rações para aquacultura em Olhão com um projeto PRR, IA@SPAROS, para levar ferramentas de IA à produção e às decisões.
organisations.es: Empresa de piensos para acuicultura en Olhão con un proyecto PRR, IA@SPAROS, para llevar herramientas de IA a la producción y a las decisiones.
organisations.fr: Entreprise d'aliments pour l'aquaculture à Olhão avec un projet PRR, IA@SPAROS, pour apporter des outils d'IA à la production et aux décisions.

organisations.name: SPIC
organisations.what: A digital studio based in the Algarve (the page does not name the town) with an R&D consortium with UAlg. In 2023 it used AI trained on more than 9,000 records to build a stage hologram for the band D'ZRT.
organisations.ai: Builds AI-made holograms and co-develops projects with UAlg.

also.what: Loulé creative and digital studio. It built the AI hologram used on stage by the band D'ZRT in 2023 (trained on more than 9,000 recordings), has an R&D consortium with the University of the Algarve, and is developing AI.EVENT, which reads audience reactions at events, with European funding per RTP.

organisations.pt: Estúdio criativo e digital de Loulé. Criou o holograma com IA usado em palco pelos D'ZRT em 2023, tem um consórcio de I&D com a Universidade do Algarve e desenvolve o AI.EVENT.
organisations.es: Estudio creativo y digital de Loulé. Creó el holograma con IA que D'ZRT usó en el escenario en 2023, tiene un consorcio de I+D con la Universidad del Algarve y desarrolla AI.EVENT.
organisations.fr: Studio créatif et numérique de Loulé. Il a créé l'hologramme avec IA utilisé sur scène par D'ZRT en 2023, a un consortium de R&D avec l'Université de l'Algarve et développe AI.EVENT.

organisations.name: StartUP Portimão
organisations.what: Business incubator at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, opened in 2017 by the council, the Autódromo and Territórios Criativos, focused on smart cities, energy, mobility and tourism. In 2022 it reported 25 startups hosted. It promoted the June 2026 Future Business Summit with an AI panel.
organisations.ai: A smart-city incubator whose community hosts AI discussions.

also.what: The council's incubator, part of the Centro de Negócios de Portimão at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, for projects with growth potential in smart cities (energy, mobility, tourism, governance, quality of life). It has an apply section on its site and a services page.

contacts.label: StartUP Portimão
contacts.channel: the official contacts page of startupportimao.pt

organisations.pt: Incubadora de empresas no Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, aberta em 2017 pela câmara, pelo Autódromo e pela Territórios Criativos, focada em cidades inteligentes, energia, mobilidade e turismo.
organisations.es: Incubadora de empresas en el Autódromo Internacional del Algarve, abierta en 2017 por el ayuntamiento, el Autódromo y Territórios Criativos, centrada en ciudades inteligentes, energía, movilidad y turismo.
organisations.fr: Incubateur d'entreprises à l'Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, ouvert en 2017 par la mairie, l'Autódromo et Territórios Criativos, axé sur les villes intelligentes, l'énergie, la mobilité et le tourisme.

organisations.name: StartUP Portimão acceleration programme
organisations.what: The 7th edition of the incubator's accelerator for entrepreneurs and business projects in the Algarve: skills, stronger business models and new market opportunities. Applications closed on 28 October 2026, with a first online bootcamp on 2 and 3 November and a second in person in Portimão on 24 and 25 November 2026. No AI theme is stated.
organisations.pt: Listado no site da incubadora como programa. A página não dá detalhes das condições.
organisations.es: Figura como programa en la web de la incubadora. La página no da detalles de las condiciones.
organisations.fr: Répertorié comme programme sur le site de l'incubateur. La page ne donne pas le détail des conditions.

organisations.name: Startup Portugal
organisations.what: Recognised the incubator in January 2026.
organisations.pt: Reconheceu a incubadora em janeiro de 2026.
organisations.es: Reconoció a la incubadora en enero de 2026.
organisations.fr: A reconnu l'incubateur en janvier 2026.

organisations.name: Strong Answer
organisations.what: An IT company in Lagoa, with more than 25 years in business by its own account, selling consulting, cloud, cybersecurity and business software, and AI agents that read mail, sort urgent items and draft replies while a person approves the final action.
organisations.ai: Sells AI agents to businesses.
organisations.pt: Empresa de informática em Lagoa, com mais de 25 anos de atividade segundo a própria, que vende consultoria, cloud, cibersegurança, software de gestão e agentes de IA que leem o correio e preparam respostas.
organisations.es: Empresa de informática en Lagoa, con más de 25 años de actividad según ella misma, que vende consultoría, nube, ciberseguridad, software de gestión y agentes de IA que leen el correo y preparan respuestas.
organisations.fr: Entreprise informatique à Lagoa, avec plus de 25 ans d'activité selon elle, qui vend du conseil, du cloud, de la cybersécurité, des logiciels de gestion et des agents d'IA qui lisent le courrier et préparent les réponses.

organisations.name: Substância3D
organisations.what: Local 3D services business listed with We Stream Algarve on the council's entrepreneur showcase.
organisations.ai: 3D content work is a field where AI generation tools are used. The page does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check.
organisations.pt: Negócio local de serviços 3D listado na montra de empreendedores da câmara.
organisations.es: Negocio local de servicios 3D que figura en el escaparate de emprendedores del ayuntamiento.
organisations.fr: Entreprise locale de services 3D répertoriée dans la vitrine des entrepreneurs de la mairie.

organisations.name: Tavira Works
organisations.what: Community whose own landing page says it aims to cultivate entrepreneurship and innovation in Tavira. Listed by name in the Algarve Tech Hub network (CCDR Algarve slides, July 2025) and as a collaborator of LOFT. The page names no organisers or events.
organisations.ai: A local tech community inside the network that also lists an Artificial Intelligence Algarve community, so AI talk reaches Tavira through it.
organisations.pt: Listada entre as comunidades tecnológicas da rede Algarve Tech Hub nos diapositivos de julho de 2025 da agência de desenvolvimento regional.
organisations.es: Figura entre las comunidades tecnológicas de la red Algarve Tech Hub en las diapositivas de julio de 2025 de la agencia de desarrollo regional.
organisations.fr: Répertoriée parmi les communautés technologiques du réseau Algarve Tech Hub dans les diapositives de juillet 2025 de l'agence de développement régional.

organisations.name: Tecnilab
organisations.what: Supplier of the AI acoustic loggers bought by EMARP. Its own location is not stated in the source.
organisations.ai: Sells the AI-driven leak-monitoring hardware that Portimão's water company installed.
organisations.pt: Fornecedora dos sensores acústicos com IA comprados pela EMARP. A fonte não indica a sua localização.
organisations.es: Proveedora de los sensores acústicos con IA comprados por EMARP. La fuente no indica su ubicación.
organisations.fr: Fournisseur des capteurs acoustiques avec IA achetés par EMARP. La source n'indique pas où il se trouve.

organisations.name: Tecnologias Imaginadas
organisations.what: Company behind the Gota Click2Care teleassistance device used in the parish of Aljezur's pilot. Its base is not stated in the source.
organisations.ai: Care technology with remote monitoring and fall alerts, close to AI in elderly care. The source does not claim AI.

also.what: IT and communications company listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator, providing enterprise systems and technical support. A speaker from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.

organisations.pt: Empresa por trás do dispositivo de teleassistência Gota Click2Care usado no piloto da freguesia de Aljezur.
organisations.es: Empresa detrás del dispositivo de teleasistencia Gota Click2Care usado en el piloto de la parroquia de Aljezur.
organisations.fr: Entreprise derrière le dispositif de téléassistance Gota Click2Care utilisé dans le pilote de la paroisse d'Aljezur.

organisations.name: Territórios Criativos
organisations.what: Partner of StartUP Portimão's founding and moderator of the February 2026 AI como Copiloto debate.
organisations.ai: Moderated a public debate on AI at work.
organisations.pt: Parceira fundadora da StartUP Portimão e moderadora do debate AI como Copiloto, em fevereiro de 2026.
organisations.es: Socia fundadora de StartUP Portimão y moderadora del debate AI como Copiloto, en febrero de 2026.
organisations.fr: Partenaire fondatrice de StartUP Portimão et modératrice du débat AI como Copiloto, en février 2026.

organisations.name: Tertúlia Algarvia
organisations.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.
organisations.ai: It is a partner of the AI and robotics tourism programme.
organisations.pt: Parceira do consórcio INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. O seu papel na IA ainda não tem fonte.
organisations.es: Socia del consorcio INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Su papel en la IA aún no tiene fuente.
organisations.fr: Partenaire du consortium INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Son rôle dans l'IA n'a pas encore de source.

organisations.name: The Collab Bar
organisations.what: Bar venue on Avenida dos Descobrimentos that hosts GDG Lagos AI talks.
organisations.ai: Host venue for AI talks.
organisations.pt: Bar na Avenida dos Descobrimentos que acolhe as palestras de IA do GDG Lagos.
organisations.es: Bar en la Avenida dos Descobrimentos que acoge las charlas de IA del GDG Lagos.
organisations.fr: Bar de l'Avenida dos Descobrimentos qui accueille les conférences d'IA du GDG Lagos.

organisations.name: Thinkerdots Technologies
organisations.what: IT consulting and information-systems company listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator. A speaker from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.
organisations.ai: A software consultancy from the incubator that spoke on a local AI panel.
organisations.pt: Empresa de consultoria informática e sistemas de informação listada na incubadora StartUP Portimão.
organisations.es: Empresa de consultoría informática y sistemas de información que figura en la incubadora StartUP Portimão.
organisations.fr: Entreprise de conseil informatique et de systèmes d'information répertoriée à l'incubateur StartUP Portimão.

organisations.name: Turismo do Algarve (Região de Turismo do Algarve)
organisations.what: Regional tourism body that runs the Competências do Futuro Algarve programme, including a free AI bootcamp for tourism professionals, and is an INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 partner.
organisations.ai: It trains tourism staff in AI tools.
organisations.pt: Entidade regional de turismo que gere o programa Competências do Futuro Algarve, com um bootcamp gratuito de IA para profissionais do turismo.
organisations.es: Entidad regional de turismo que gestiona el programa Competências do Futuro Algarve, con un bootcamp gratuito de IA para profesionales del turismo.
organisations.fr: Organisme régional du tourisme qui gère le programme Competências do Futuro Algarve, avec un bootcamp gratuit d'IA pour les professionnels du tourisme.

organisations.name: UAlg proof-of-concept programme (CRIA)
organisations.what: Takes technology projects from maturity level 3 to 6 towards demonstration in a real setting. The June 2026 call closed on 10 July.
organisations.pt: Leva projetos tecnológicos do nível de maturidade 3 ao 6, até à demonstração em ambiente real. O aviso de junho de 2026 fechou a 10 de julho.
organisations.es: Lleva proyectos tecnológicos del nivel de madurez 3 al 6, hasta la demostración en entorno real. La convocatoria de junio de 2026 cerró el 10 de julio.
organisations.fr: Fait passer des projets technologiques du niveau de maturité 3 au niveau 6, jusqu'à la démonstration en conditions réelles. L'appel de juin 2026 a fermé le 10 juillet.

organisations.name: UALG TEC Campus
organisations.what: The University of Algarve's technology incubator and accelerator on its Penha campus in Faro, opened in March 2022 with about 16 companies and 300 workers, mostly in information technology. It has since hosted the July 2026 AI search panel, the 30 September 2026 founders' book launch and Vibathon Algarve 2026 on 31 October.
organisations.ai: Hosts startups and AI events.

also.what: Technology incubator and accelerator on UAlg's Penha campus in Faro, opened in 2022, mostly information technology.

organisations.pt: A incubadora e aceleradora tecnológica da Universidade do Algarve no campus da Penha, em Faro, aberta em março de 2022 com cerca de 16 empresas e 300 trabalhadores, sobretudo em tecnologias de informação.
organisations.es: La incubadora y aceleradora tecnológica de la Universidad del Algarve en el campus de Penha, en Faro, abierta en marzo de 2022 con unas 16 empresas y 300 trabajadores, sobre todo en tecnologías de la información.
organisations.fr: L'incubateur et accélérateur technologique de l'Université de l'Algarve sur le campus de Penha, à Faro, ouvert en mars 2022 avec environ 16 entreprises et 300 salariés, surtout dans les technologies de l'information.

organisations.name: ULS Algarve
organisations.what: The Algarve's local health unit, which held a webinar on AI in the national health service on 15 September 2026.
organisations.ai: A public health body debating AI in care.

also.what: The regional health unit ran a webinar on AI in the national health service in September 2026 and is named in the AI healthcare course.

organisations.pt: A unidade local de saúde do Algarve, que fez um webinar sobre IA no Serviço Nacional de Saúde a 15 de setembro de 2026.
organisations.es: La unidad local de salud del Algarve, que hizo un webinar sobre IA en el Servicio Nacional de Salud el 15 de septiembre de 2026.
organisations.fr: L'unité locale de santé de l'Algarve, qui a tenu un webinaire sur l'IA dans le Service national de santé le 15 septembre 2026.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg)
organisations.what: The Algarve's public university, with its main contact address in Faro. Published an AI use policy on 24 September 2026.
organisations.ai: Sets AI policy and hosts AI research and courses.

also.what: A named organiser of the Algarve Tech Hub Summit held in Lagos in November 2025.

Public university with campuses in Faro (Penha and Gambelas) and Portimão. Launched its AI use policy in September 2026, runs AI courses with partners, hosted the EPIA 2025 conference and leads UAlgTec Heritage.

partner.note: Partner in ADI, the Tech Hub Summit, education, and the lead promoter of the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: A universidade pública do Algarve, com a morada principal em Faro. Publicou uma política de uso da IA a 24 de setembro de 2026.
organisations.es: La universidad pública del Algarve, con su dirección principal en Faro. Publicó una política de uso de la IA el 24 de septiembre de 2026.
organisations.fr: L'université publique de l'Algarve, dont l'adresse principale est à Faro. Elle a publié une politique d'usage de l'IA le 24 septembre 2026.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg), Portimão campus
organisations.what: Has a small existing campus in Portimão and a signed protocol with the council for a new technology-focused campus at Barranco do Rodrigo, with digital, data and AI as focus areas, linked by its rector to research with the Autódromo and Celerator technology park.
organisations.ai: Plans a Portimão campus focused on digital, data and AI.
organisations.pt: Tem um pequeno campus em Portimão e um protocolo com a câmara para um novo campus tecnológico no Barranco do Rodrigo, dedicado ao digital, aos dados e à IA.
organisations.es: Tiene un pequeño campus en Portimão y un protocolo con el ayuntamiento para un nuevo campus tecnológico en Barranco do Rodrigo, dedicado a lo digital, los datos y la IA.
organisations.fr: Elle a un petit campus à Portimão et un protocole avec la mairie pour un nouveau campus technologique à Barranco do Rodrigo, consacré au numérique, aux données et à l'IA.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve and CCMAR, Sagres marine biology laboratory
organisations.what: A teaching and research laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, planned with the municipality and funded by the Fosteam@South project, about 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience money, as reported in June 2023. The Universidade do Algarve's page shows the Sagres Marine Station hosted the Sagres Marine Science Festival from 6 to 9 May 2026, with the municipality as co-organiser.
organisations.ai: Candidate only. The article describes reef mapping and sampling, not AI. Path: marine research, then ocean data and mapping, then AI analysis. Unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Laboratório de ensino e investigação no Porto da Baleeira, planeado com o município e financiado pelo projeto Fosteam@South.
organisations.es: Laboratorio de enseñanza e investigación en el Porto da Baleeira, planificado con el municipio y financiado por el proyecto Fosteam@South.
organisations.fr: Laboratoire d'enseignement et de recherche au Porto da Baleeira, prévu avec la commune et financé par le projet Fosteam@South.

organisations.name: University of the Algarve (R&D consortium with SPIC)
organisations.what: UAlg's own page says it has a research and development consortium with Loulé's SPIC on information technology and human-interaction research. UAlg's campuses are in Faro and Portimão, so the link here is the partnership.
organisations.ai: UAlg co-develops AI projects with a Loulé company.
organisations.pt: A UAlg diz ter um consórcio de investigação e desenvolvimento com a SPIC, de Loulé, em tecnologias de informação e interação humana.
organisations.es: La UAlg dice tener un consorcio de investigación y desarrollo con SPIC, de Loulé, en tecnologías de la información e interacción humana.
organisations.fr: L'UAlg dit avoir un consortium de recherche et développement avec SPIC, de Loulé, dans les technologies de l'information et l'interaction humaine.

organisations.name: Venture Lab by Algarve STP
organisations.what: Free mentoring for 12 validated Algarve startups and SMEs, funded by Algarve 2030. The 2026 call closed on 24 June.

organisations.name: Vicentina, development association of the southwest (LEADER local action group, Adere programmes)
organisations.what: Regional development association whose funding calls have covered Vila do Bispo with Aljezur and Monchique. A 2020 call, +CO3SO Emprego Interior, funded job creation including self-employment in micro and small firms in low-density areas, 2.0 million euros across three measures. The call is old, so check what is open now.
organisations.pt: Associação de desenvolvimento regional cujos avisos abrangeram Vila do Bispo, Aljezur e Monchique. O aviso de 2020 é antigo, por isso confirme o que está aberto agora.
organisations.es: Asociación de desarrollo regional cuyas convocatorias abarcaron Vila do Bispo, Aljezur y Monchique. La convocatoria de 2020 es antigua, así que confirme lo que está abierto ahora.
organisations.fr: Association de développement régional dont les appels ont couvert Vila do Bispo, Aljezur et Monchique. L'appel de 2020 est ancien : vérifiez ce qui est ouvert aujourd'hui.

organisations.name: Vilamoura World (Arrow Global), developer and marina operator
organisations.what: Develops Vilamoura and its new 68-berth marina, designed with remote monitoring of water and electricity use at the berths and charging points for electric boats (reported January 2024).
organisations.ai: The resort owner runs metered, remotely monitored infrastructure, a data base for optimisation tools. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Desenvolve Vilamoura e a sua nova marina de 68 lugares, com monitorização remota de água e eletricidade e carregadores para barcos elétricos.
organisations.es: Desarrolla Vilamoura y su nuevo puerto deportivo de 68 amarres, con supervisión remota del agua y la electricidad y cargadores para barcos eléctricos.
organisations.fr: Aménage Vilamoura et sa nouvelle marina de 68 places, avec suivi à distance de l'eau et de l'électricité et des bornes de recharge pour bateaux électriques.
